atcCategory: Various - Diagnostic Radiopharmaceuticals
indications: Indicated for positron emission tomography (PET) imaging in the following setting:

i. Oncology: For assessment of abnormal glucose metabolism to assist in the evaluation of malignancy in patients with known or suspected abnormalities found by other testing modalities, or in patients with an existing diagnosis of cancer

ii. Cardiology: For the identification of left ventricular myocardium with residual glucose metabolism and reversible loss of systolic function in patients with coronary artery disease and left ventricular dysfunction, when used together with myocardial perfusion imaging.
iii. Neurology: For the identification of regions of abnormal glucose metabolism associated with foci or epileptic seizures
contraindications: It is contraindicated in pregnant and lactating women.
psxRestrictions: To be prescribed by Nuclear Medicine Specialist only

standardDosage.adult: The recommended dose is 6 Mbq/kg (0.162 mCi/kg). Example, for an adult with a body weight of 70 kg, the recommended dose is 420 Mbq (11 mCi)
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos pada bayi dan kanak-kanak wajib dihitung berdasarkan berat badan (mg/kg) mengikut garis panduan Formulari Pediatrik KKM. Rundingan pakar disyorkan untuk penggunaan luar label atau neonat.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos standard.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Gangguan sederhana — pertimbangkan pengurangan dos 25-50% atau panjangkan selang pemberian.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Gangguan teruk — titrasi berhati-hati dengan pemantauan klinikal dan makmal.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Mulakan pada julat dos terendah (50% daripada dos pemula dewasa standard) dan titrasi secara perlahan dengan pemantauan fungsi buah pinggang dan kognitif.

sideEffects: Not known
cautionsAndWarnings: Patients should avoid extreme activity, and the blood glucose levels should be stabilized before FDG Putra Injection is administered (See Patient Preparation section in the package insert). The patient should be rested and kept isolated from anybody for at least 1 hour after injection.

interactions.interactingDrug: Ubat Nefrotoksik / Hepatotoksik / Dimetabolismekan oleh CYP450
interactions.effect: All iron-containing medications and diabetic medications (See Patient Preparation section in the package insert).

incompatibleDiluents: Jangan campur bersama ubat IV lain dalam picagari atau tiub infusi yang sama tanpa data keserasian fizikal/kimia.

storageConditions.specialStorageNote: Simpan pada suhu bilik terkawal (<30°C). Lindungi daripada cahaya matahari terus.

postDilutionStability.roomTempDuration: Habiskan infusi dalam tempoh 12 hingga 24 jam pada 25°C

shelfLife.multiDoseVialPolicy: Single Use Only - Discard Remainder

pregnancyAndLactation.pregnancyReason: Tiada bukti teratogenik manusia yang kukuh, tetapi data klinikal kehamilan adalah terhad. Gunakan dos terendah yang berkesan sekiranya tiada alternatif Kategori A/B.
pregnancyAndLactation.trimester1: Gunakan hanya jika ada indikasi klinikal mustahak yang disahkan oleh Pakar Perubatan.
pregnancyAndLactation.trimester2_3: Pantau perkembangan janin dan tanda-tanda klinikal ibu secara berkala.
pregnancyAndLactation.lactationReason: Kuantiti kecil mungkin dikumuhkan ke dalam susu ibu. Ambil dos sejurus selepas menyusukan bayi bagi meminimumkan kepekatan dalam susu.
pregnancyAndLactation.infantMonitoringAdvice: Pantau bayi untuk sebarang tanda kelesuan luar biasa, perubahan selera menyusu, atau cirit-birit.

atcCategory: Antiinfectives for Systemic Use - Antivirals for Systemic Use
indications: Antiretroviral combination therapy of HIV infection in adults and adolescents from 12 years of age.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity reaction to the active substance or to any excipients.
psxRestrictions:
i. Patients unsuitable or failed other HAART treatment
ii. Patients who have renal impairment (CrCl < 50ml/min) when Abacavir and Lamivudine fixed-dose combination is not recommended

standardDosage.adult: 300mg twice daily or 600mg daily
standardDosage.pediatric:
Kanak-kanak ≥ 3 bulan:
• Berat 14 hingga <20 kg: 150 mg (setengah tablet 300mg) 2 kali sehari (BD).
• Berat 20 hingga <25 kg: 150 mg pagi + 300 mg (1 tablet penuh) malam.
• Berat ≥ 25 kg: 300 mg 2 kali sehari (BD) atau 600 mg sekali sehari (OD).
(Cecair oral: 8 mg/kg/dos 2 kali sehari; Maksimum: 300 mg BD). Wajib saring HLA-B*5701 sebelum rawatan.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos penuh normal.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Kurangkan dos harian sebanyak 50% atau panjangkan selang dos.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min: Selang masa Q24H - Q48H.
• Hemodialisis: Berikan dos tambahan selepas dialisis.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Pantau fungsi renal dan toleransi sistem saraf pusat.

sideEffects: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, fever, lethargy, fatigue, rash, anorexia, headache, hyperlactatemia, pancreatitis, lactic acidosis, rash, erythema multiforme, Stevens-Johnson syndrome and toxic epidermal necrolysis.
cautionsAndWarnings: Hypersensitivity, lactic acidosis/ severe hepatomegaly with steatosis, elevated serum lipids and blood glucose, immune reconstitution syndrome, opportunistic infections, transmission of infection, myocardial infarction

interactions.interactingDrug: Ubat Nefrotoksik / Hepatotoksik / Dimetabolismekan oleh CYP450
interactions.effect: Ribavirin, ethanol, methadone and retinoids.

storageConditions.specialStorageNote: Simpan dalam bekas asal yang bertutup rapat pada suhu bilik terkawal (<30°C). Lindungi daripada cahaya matahari terus dan kelembapan.

inUseStabilityNotes.blisterPackStability: Kekal stabil sehingga tarikh luput pengilang selagi pek lepuh (blister foil) tidak pecah atau berlubang.
inUseStabilityNotes.looseBottleStability: Gunakan dalam tempoh 6 bulan selepas penutup botol dibuka (atau sehingga tarikh luput asal, yang mana lebih awal).

shelfLife.multiDoseVialPolicy: Guna Dalam 6 Bulan Selepas Buka Botol (Pek Botol)

pregnancyAndLactation.pregnancyVerdict: BOLEH DIGUNAKAN (PENCEGAHAN TRANSMISI IBU-KE-ANAK / PMTCT KKM)
pregnancyAndLactation.pregnancyReason: Sangat penting untuk menekan paras virus HIV ibu ke tahap tidak dapat dikesan (undetectable viral load) bagi menghapuskan risiko jangkitan HIV kepada janin semasa dalam kandungan dan kelahiran (Protokol PMTCT KKM).
pregnancyAndLactation.trimester1: Saringan genetik HLA-B*5701 wajib negatif sebelum ubat dimulakan.
pregnancyAndLactation.trimester2_3: Kekalkan kepatuhan rawatan 100% dan pantau viral load menjelang kelahiran.
pregnancyAndLactation.lactationVerdict: DILARANG MENYUSU (GUNA SUSU FORMULA GANTIAN PENUH)
pregnancyAndLactation.lactationReason: Garis Panduan KKM & Hospital menetapkan bahawa ibu positif HIV tidak menyusukan bayi secara terus bagi mengelakkan penularan virus HIV melalui susu ibu. Susu formula gantian dibekalkan sepenuhnya.
pregnancyAndLactation.infantMonitoringAdvice: Bayi perlu menerima profilaksis antiretroviral (Zidovudine / Nevirapine sirap) mengikut Garis Panduan Pediatrik KKM dan ujian saringan DNA PCR HIV berkala.

• Berat ≥ 25 kg: 300 mg 2 kali sehari (BD) atau 600 mg sekali sehari (OD).
(Cecair oral: 8 mg/kg/dos 2 kali sehari; Maksimum: 300 mg BD). Wajib saring HLA-B*5701 sebelum rawatan.

• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos penuh normal.

• Hemodialisis: Berikan dos tambahan selepas dialisis.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Pantau fungsi renal dan toleransi sistem saraf pusat.

sideEffects: Hypersensitivity, anorexia, headache, insomnia, cough, nasal symptoms, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain or cramps, diarrhea, rash, alopecia, fever, lethargy, fatigue, malaise.
cautionsAndWarnings: Close monitoring is required in patients with mild and moderate hepatic impairment.
Discontinue treatment immediately if hypersensitivity is suspected.
Not recommended in patients with creatinine clearance < 50ml/min

atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Antineoplastic Agents
indications: Abemaciclib, in combination with endocrine therapy, is indicated for the adjuvant treatment of adult patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative, node-positive early breast cancer at high risk of recurrence.
In pre- or perimenopausal women, aromatase inhibitor endocrine therapy should be combined with a luteinising hormone-releasing hormone (LHRH) agonist.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or any of the excipients listed.
psxRestrictions:
i.	For high-risk stage II and III early breast cancer. High risk defined by clinical and pathological features: either ≥4 pALN (positive axillary lymph nodes) or 1 – 3 pALN and at least one of the following criteria: tumour size ≥5cm or histological grade 3.
ii.	To be prescribed by Oncologist only

standardDosage.adult: The recommended dosing is 150mg twice daily, taken orally with or without food for 2 years, or until disease recurrence or unacceptable toxicity occurs
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos kemoterapi dalam pediatrik adalah berasaskan protokol ketat dihitung menggunakan Luas Permukaan Badan (mg/m²) atau berat (mg/kg) mengikut Protokol Onkologi Pediatrik Malaysia (MASPO / SIOP). Memerlukan pengesahan bebas dua pegawai farmasi onkologi.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: 100% dos protokol.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Pengurangan dos mengikut protokol onkologi khusus (biasanya pengurangan 25-50% untuk Cisplatin, Carboplatin, Methotrexate, Capecitabine).
• CrCl < 10 mL/min: Semakan ketat Pakar Onkologi.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Nilai status prestasi (ECOG / Indeks Frailty), rizab sumsum tulang, dan fungsi renal sebelum setiap kitaran rawatan.

sideEffects: Diarrhoea, neutropenia, nausea, abdominal pain, infections, fatigue, anaemia, leukopenia, decreased appetite, vomiting, headache, alopecia, and thrombocytopenia.
cautionsAndWarnings: Diarrhoea, neutropenia, Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD)/pneumonitis, hepatotoxicity, venous thromboembolism, embryo-fetal toxicity

interactions.interactingDrug: CYP3A Inhibitors
interactions.effect: CYP3A Inhibitors: ketoconazole, CYP3A Inducers

atcCategory: Dermatologicals - Antipsoriatics
indications: i) Severe form of psoriasis including erythrodermic psoriasis and local or generalized pustular psoriasis.

contraindications: Pregnancy, women of childbearing potential unless strict contraception is practised 4 weeks before, during and for 2 years after treatment, severely impaired liver or kidney function and in patient with chronic abnormally elevated blood lipid values, hypersensitivity to the preparation (acitretin or excipients) or to other retinoids.

standardDosage.adult:
ADULT: initially 25-30 mg daily for 2-4 weeks, then adjusted according to response, usually within range 25-50 mg daily for further 6-8 weeks (max: 75 mg daily).

standardDosage.pediatric: Topikal & Oftalmik: Sapukan lapisan nipis pada kawasan terjejas 1-2 kali sehari. Pada bayi, elakkan kortikosteroid topikal berpotensi tinggi pada kawasan permukaan luas atau di bawah lampin kerana penyerapan sistemik dan penindasan paksi HPA.

Tiada pelarasan dos diperlukan untuk formulasi topikal dan oftalmik kerana penyerapan sistemik yang sangat minimum.

sideEffects: Symptoms of hypervitaminosis A, dried mucous membranes and transitional epithelia, xeriophthalmia, conjunctivitis, corneal ulcerations, cheilitis, stomatitis, gingivitis and taste disturbances, vulvovaginitis, thinning and scaling of the skin, sticky skin, dermatitis, erythema and pruritus, increased hair loss, nail fragility and paronychia, blurred vision and impaired night vision, muscle and joint pain, peripheral edema and flushing, High dose: reversible elevation of serum triglycerides and serum cholesterol.
cautionsAndWarnings: Long-term treatment, diabetes, obesity, alcoholism, disturbances of lipid metabolism

Indication (i)
Treatment for Herpes Simplex: 
ADULT - 200mg 5 times daily; In severely immune-compromised patients: dose can be doubled to 400 mg. 
CHILD - two years and above should be given adult dosages, infants and children below two years old should be given half the adult dose.

Treatment for Varicella Zoster: 
ADULT - 800mg 5 times daily; 
CHILD 
6 years and over: 800 mg four times daily,
2 - < 6 years: 400 mg four times daily, 
Under 2 years: 200 mg four times daily.

Indication (ii)
ADULT - Immune-compromised patients: 200 mg four times daily. Severely immune-compromised patients: dose can be doubled to 400 mg.
CHILD - two years and above should be given adult dosages, infants and children below two years old should be given half the adult dose.

Dosing is according to Product Information Leaflet.

atcCategory: Dermatologicals - Antibiotics and Chemotherapeutics for Dermatological Use
therapeuticClass: Antibiotics and Chemotherapeutics for Dermatological Use
indications: Herpes simplex infections of the skin, including initial and recurrent labial and genital herpes simplex infections
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to acyclovir or valacyclovir

standardDosage.adult: Apply every 4 hours for 5 - 10 days
standardDosage.pediatric: Bayi & Kanak-kanak (>1 bulan): Dos berasaskan berat badan (mg/kg/hari) dibahagikan mengikut selang masa piawai KKM (Q6H/Q8H/Q12H) mengikut indikasi dan tahap keterukan jangkitan (NAG 2024 Edisi Ke-4). Bagi neonat (<28 hari), dos wajib dilaraskan mengikut umur gestasi dan berat lahir.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: 100% dos normal piawai.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Kurangkan dos sebanyak 25 - 50% atau panjangkan selang masa pemberian (Q12H - Q24H).
• CrCl < 10 mL/min: Kurangkan dos sebanyak 50 - 75% (Q24H - Q48H).
• Hemodialisis: Berikan dos tambahan selepas setiap sesi hemodialisis pada hari dialisis.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Kira pelepasan kreatinin (CrCl) menggunakan formula Cockcroft-Gault untuk warga emas bagi mengelakkan ketoksikan ubat.

sideEffects: Transient burning or stinging or erythema, mild drying or flaking of the skin
cautionsAndWarnings: Application to mucous membranes, pregnancy, lactation. Should not be used in the eyes

interactions.interactingDrug: Ubat Nefrotoksik / Hepatotoksik / Dimetabolismekan oleh CYP450
interactions.effect: Not known

atcCategory: Antiinfectives for Systemic Use - Antivirals for Systemic Use
indications: i)Treatment of Herpes simplex & Varicella zoster infections
ii)Prophylaxis of Herpes simplex infections in immune-compromised patients
contraindications: Patients known to be hypersensitivity to acyclovir

standardDosage.adult:
Indication (i)
Treatment for Herpes Simplex: ADULT - 200mg 5 times daily; In severely immune-compromised patients: dose can be doubled to 400 mg. CHILD - two years and above should be given adult dosages, infants and children below two years old should be given half the adult dose.

Treatment for Varicella Zoster: ADULT - 800mg 5 times daily; CHILD - 6 years and over: 800 mg four times daily, 2 - < 6 years: 400 mg four times daily, Under 2 years: 200 mg four times daily.

Indication (ii)
ADULT - Immune-compromised patients: 200 mg four times daily. Severely immune-compromised patients: dose can be doubled to 400 mg.
CHILD - two years and above should be given adult dosages, infants and children below two years old should be given half the adult dose.

Dosing is according to Product Information Leaflet.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos pediatrik dihitung mengikut berat badan (mg/kg/dos) per indikasi klinikal FUKKM. Bagi neonat (<28 hari), dos diselaraskan mengikut berat lahir dan umur gestasi.

cautionsAndWarnings: Patients with pre-existing neurologic, renal, or hepatic impairment, dehydrated patient, elderly and lactation

atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Immunosuppressants
indications: i) Third line treatment of:
- Severe rheumatoid arthritis
- Psoriatic arthritis
- For reducing signs and symptoms in patients with active ankylosing spondylitis, after failure of conventional DMARDs or other biologics.

ii)Treatment of adults with moderate to severe chronic plaque psoriasis who have not responded to, have contraindication or are unable to tolerate phototherapy and/or systemic therapies including acitretin, methotreaxate and cyclosporine
iii) Crohn's Disease
a) For treatment of moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease in adult patients who have inadequate response to conventional therapy
b) For treatment of moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease in adult patients who have lost response to or are intolerant to infliximab
iv) Ulcerative Colitis

- For treatment of moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis in adult patients who have had an inadequate response to conventional therapy including corticosteroids and 6-mercaptopurine or azathioprine, or who are intolerant to or have medical contraindications for such therapies
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to adalimumab or any component of the formulation, severe infection

standardDosage.adult:
i)Severe rheumatoid arthritis, Psoriatic arthritis, Ankylosing spondylitis : Subcutaneous 40 mg every other week 

ii)Chronic plaque psoriasis : Initial, 80 mg SC, followed by 40 mg SC every other week starting one week after the initial dose 

iii) & iv) Crohn's disease & Ulcerative colitis: 
160mg at week 0 (dose can be administered as four injections in one day or as two injections per day for two consecutive days) and 80mg at week 2. After induction treatment, the recommended maintenance dose is 40mg every other week via subcutaneous injection.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos pada bayi dan kanak-kanak wajib dihitung berdasarkan berat badan (mg/kg) mengikut garis panduan Formulari Pediatrik KKM. Rundingan pakar disyorkan untuk penggunaan luar label atau neonat.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos standard.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Gangguan sederhana — pertimbangkan pengurangan dos 25-50% atau panjangkan selang pemberian.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Gangguan teruk — titrasi berhati-hati dengan pemantauan klinikal dan makmal.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Mulakan pada julat dos terendah (50% daripada dos pemula dewasa standard) dan titrasi secara perlahan dengan pemantauan fungsi buah pinggang dan kognitif.

sideEffects: Hypertension, injection site reaction, rash, autoantibody, erythema multiforme, primary cutaneous vasculitis, Stevens-Johnson Syndrome, aplastic anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, anaphylaxis, malignant lymphoma, multiple sclerosis, paraesthesia, subdural hematoma, interstitial lung disease, angioedema, fatal infectious disease including tuberculosis, invasive fungal infections and other opportunistic infections
cautionsAndWarnings: Reactivation of tuberculosis (patients should be evaluated for tuberculosis before treatment), serious infection, lupus-like syndrome & confirmed significant hematologic abnormalities, CHF & development of symptoms of blood dyscrasias, women of childbearing potential, pregnancy & lactation

indications: Rapid conversion of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia to sinus rhythm
contraindications: Bradycardia, bronchoconstrictive or bronchospastic lung disease (eg. asthma). Hypersensitivity to adenosine, second-degree or third-degree AV block (unless pacemaker fitted), sinus node disease (eg. sick sinus syndrome)

standardDosage.adult: ADULT: Initially: 3 mg given as a rapid IV bolus (over 2 seconds). Second dose: If the first dose does not result in elimination of the supraventricular tachycardia with in 1 or 2 minutes, 6 mg should be given also as a rapid IV bolus. Third dose: If the second dose does not result in elimination of the supraventicular tachycardia with in 1-2 minutes, 12 mg should be given also as a rapid IV bolus

atcCategory: Sensory Organs - Ophthalmologicals
indications: i) Treatment of neovascular (wet) age-related macular degeneration (wet AMD)
ii) Visual impairment due to diabetic macular edema (DME)
iii) Macular Oedema secondary to Retinal Vein Occlusion (branch RVO or central RVO)
contraindications: Recent (<3months) cerebral vascular accident or cardiovascular disease.
Ocular or periocular infection.
Active severe intraocular inflammation.
Known hypersensitivity to aflibercept or to any of the excipients.
psxRestrictions:
For all indications:
To be used by ophthalmologists only 

For indication (ii):
a) Treatment of naive patients with visual acuity equal or worse than 20/50; or 
b) Patients with poor response to treatment with ranibizumab.

For indication (iii):
a) First line for patient not able to comply with monthly ranibizumab injection after initial loading doses
b) Second line for patient who are refractory to ranibizumab injection
c) To be prescribed by Ophthalmologist only

standardDosage.adult:
i) The recommended dose is 2mg aflibercept, equivalent to 0.05mL (50 μL) given as intra-vitreal injection. Aflibercept treatment is initiated with one injection per month for three consecutive doses, followed by one injection every two months.

ii) 2 mg aflibercept (equivalent to 50 microliters) administered by intravitreal injection monthly for the first 5 consecutive doses, followed by one injection every 2 months. There is no requirement for monitoring between injections. 

iii) 2 mg aflibercept (equivalent to 50 microliters) administered by intravitreal injection monthly. The interval between two doses should not be shorter than one month.
standardDosage.pediatric: Topikal & Oftalmik: Sapukan lapisan nipis pada kawasan terjejas 1-2 kali sehari. Pada bayi, elakkan kortikosteroid topikal berpotensi tinggi pada kawasan permukaan luas atau di bawah lampin kerana penyerapan sistemik dan penindasan paksi HPA.

cautionsAndWarnings: Endophthalmitis, increase in intraocular pressure. Pregnancy and lactation.

genericName: Alendronate Sodium 70mg and Cholecalciferol 5600 IU Tablet
atcCategory: Musculo-skeletal System - Drugs for Treatment of Bone Diseases
therapeuticClass: Drugs for Treatment of Bone Diseases
indications: i) Osteoporosis in postmenopausal women with a history of vertebral fracture and whom oestrogen replacement therapy is contraindicated
ii) Male Osteoporosis
contraindications: Abnornalities of the esophagus which delay esophageal emptying such as stricture or achalasia. Inability to stand or sit upright for at least 30 minutes. Hypersensitivity to any component of the product. Hypocalcemia.

standardDosage.adult:
1 tablet once weekly [70mg/5600 IU]. Patient should receive supplemental calcium or vitamin D, if dietary vitamin D inadequate. 
The tablet should be taken at least half and hour before the first food, beverage, or medication of the day with plain water only. To facilitate delivery to stomach and thus reduce the potential for esophageal irritation, it should only be swallowed upon arising for the day with a full glass of water and patient should not lie down for at least 30 minutes and until after their first food of the day.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos pada bayi dan kanak-kanak wajib dihitung berdasarkan berat badan (mg/kg) mengikut garis panduan Formulari Pediatrik KKM. Rundingan pakar disyorkan untuk penggunaan luar label atau neonat.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos standard.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Gangguan sederhana — pertimbangkan pengurangan dos 25-50% atau panjangkan selang pemberian.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Gangguan teruk — titrasi berhati-hati dengan pemantauan klinikal dan makmal.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Mulakan pada julat dos terendah (50% daripada dos pemula dewasa standard) dan titrasi secara perlahan dengan pemantauan fungsi buah pinggang dan kognitif.

sideEffects: Abdominal pain, dyspepsia, esophageal ulcer, dysphagia, abdominal distention, musculoskeletal (bone, muscle or joint) pain, constipation, diarrhea, flatulence, headache, acid regurgitation, muscle cramp, gastritis, gastric ulcer, urticaria, nausea, vomiting, esophagitis, esophageal erosions, dizziness, vertigo, dysgeusia, rash, pruritis, alopecia.
cautionsAndWarnings: Review treatment after 2 years and if there is positive response, treatment may be continued up to 5 years and then re-evaluate. Treatment should be stopped if there is no positive response after 5 years. Otherwise, patient needs to be given drug holiday for 1 to 2 years and then continue treatment shall the benefit outweigh the risk.

Discontinue in case of dysphagia, odynophagia, retrosternal pain or new or worsening heartburn. Active upper gastrointestinal problems (dysphagia, esophageal diseases, gastritis, duodenitis or ulcers). CrCl less 35 ml/min. Correct hypocalcemia and other disorders affecting mineral metabolism (eg vit D deficiency) before starting therapy. Monitor serum Calcium and urine. Children, pregnancy and lactation

interactions.effect: If taken at the same time it is likely that calcium supplements, antacids, and other oral medications will interfere with absorption of alendronate. cautionsAndWarnings: Avoid operating vehicles or machinery, abuse prone patient, pregnancy and breastfeeding, renal or hepatic dysfunction, elderly patients, obesity, untreated open angle glaucoma, impaired pulmonary function. Prolonged use can lead to dependence

atcCategory: Blood and Blood Forming Organs - Antithrombotic Agents
indications: Thrombolytic treatment of acute ischaemic stroke.
contraindications: In the indication acute ischaemic stroke the following contraindications apply in addition: Symptoms of ischaemic attack began more than 4.5 hours prior to infusion start or when time of symptom onset is unknown, symptoms of acute ischaemic stroke that were either rapidly improving or only minor before start of infusion, severe stroke as assessed clinically (e.g. NIHSS>25) and/or by appropriate imaging techniques, seizure at the onset of stroke, history of previous stroke or serious head-trauma within three months, a combination of previous stroke and diabetes mellitus, administration of heparin within 48 hours preceding the onset of stroke with an elevated activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) at presentation, platelet count of less than 100,000 / mm3 , systolic blood pressure > 185 or diastolic blood pressure > 110 mm Hg, or aggressive management (IV medication) necessary to reduce blood pressure to these limits, blood glucose < 50 or > 400 mg/dl. Alteplase is not indicated for the therapy of acute stroke in children and adolescents under 18 years.

standardDosage.adult: 0.9 mg/kg (maximum of 90 mg) infused over 60 minutes with 10% of the total dose administered as an initial intravenous bolus. Treatment must be started as early as possible within 4.5 hours after onset of stroke symptoms and after exclusion of intracranial haemorrhage by appropriate imaging technique.
standardDosage.pediatric: Antikoagulasi pediatrik diawasi ketat oleh Pakar Hematologi Pediatrik mengikut Protokol KKM. Enoxaparin rawatan: Neonates 1.5 - 2.0 mg/kg SC Q12H; Kanak-kanak 1.0 mg/kg SC Q12H (Sasaran Anti-Xa: 0.5 - 1.0 unit/mL). Warfarin: Pemula 0.1 - 0.2 mg/kg PO OD (Sasaran INR 2.0 - 3.0).
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos normal.
• CrCl 30 - 50 mL/min: Enoxaparin dos normal atau kurangkan pada warga emas; DOAC kurangkan dos.
• CrCl < 30 mL/min: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC sekali sehari (OD); DOAC adalah KONTRAINDIKASI / ELAKKAN; Warfarin / Heparin Tidak Terpecah (UFH) lebih diutamakan.
• Hemodialisis: UFH semasa sesi dialisis.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Risiko pendarahan tinggi (Skor HAS-BLED). Pantau risiko jatuh, pendarahan saluran gastrousus tersembunyi, dan pendarahan intrakranial.

sideEffects: The most common and serious side effect with alteplase is bleeding. Minor bleeding is more common, but significant bleeding such as into the brain or fatal bleeding also occurs. Nausea, vomiting, and allergic reactions also occur.
cautionsAndWarnings: Bleeding disorders, high blood pressure, recent injury or surgery, liver disease, endocarditis, any allergies. Use extra caution to avoid injury and trauma while using this medication due to the increased risk of bleeding. This medication should be used only if clearly needed during pregnancy.

interactions.interactingDrug: Ubat Nefrotoksik / Hepatotoksik / Dimetabolismekan oleh CYP450
interactions.effect: Alteplase breaks down clots and thereby interferes with the body's ability to stop bleeding. Therefore, drugs which also interfere with the body's ability to form blood clots (or the clot-promoting effects of platelets) increase the risk of bleeding in patients receiving alteplase. Such drugs include warfarin, aspirin, and nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) such as ibuprofen, naproxen, nabumetone, and platelet inhibitors such as clopidogrel.

incompatibleDiluents: Jangan campur bersama ubat IV lain dalam picagari atau tiub infusi yang sama tanpa data keserasian fizikal/kimia.

atcCategory: Respiratory System - Drugs for Obstructive Airway Diseases
indications: Reversible airways obstruction, acute severe brochospasm
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to theophylline or derivatives, hypersensitivity to ethylenediamine

standardDosage.adult: Loading dose: 6 mg/kg (ideal body weight) or 250-500 mg (25 mg/ml) by slow inj or infusion over 20-30 min. Maintenance infusion dose: 0.5 mg/kg/hr. Max rate: 25 mg/min.
standardDosage.pediatric: Kanak-kanak < 5 tahun: Wajib diberikan melalui Metered Dose Inhaler (MDI) bersama Valved Holding Chamber (Spacer) dan topeng muka. Kanak-kanak > 5 tahun: Spacer dengan mouthpiece atau Dry Powder Inhaler (DPI) jika aliran inspiratori mencukupi. Dos per panduan GINA & Asma Pediatrik KKM.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 10 mL/min: Dos sedutan normal.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Dialisis: Dos sedutan normal (penyerapan sistemik minimum).

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Pastikan teknik inhaler dan kekuatan genggaman pesakit disemak. Gunakan peranti spacer jika koordinasi tangan-nafas lemah.

sideEffects: Tachycardia, palpitations, nausea and other gastrointestinal disturbances, headache, CNS stimulation, insomnia, arrythmias, also allergy to ethylenediamine which can cause urticaria, erythema, and exfoliative dermatitis
cautionsAndWarnings: Should not be administered concurrently with ephedrine or with other xanthine medications. Use with caution paediatrics, elderly patients, smokers ,patients undergoing influenza immunisation, patient with reduced hepatic clearance.Patients with ischaemic heart disease, hypertension,hyperthyroidism, epilepsy, history of peptic ulcer disease, glaucoma, diabetis mellitus, severe hypoxemia, angina pectoris, acute mycardial injury or pre-existing arrythmias.

interactions.interactingDrug: Azole antifungals, ciprofloxacin, clarithromycin, erythromycin

atcCategory: Cardiovascular System - Cardiac Therapy
indications: Arrhythmias
contraindications: Cardiogenic shock, hypersensitivity to amiodarone, second or third degree AV block (if no pacemaker is present). Severe sinus bradycardia and severe sinus-node dysfunction

standardDosage.adult:
200 mg 3 times daily for 1 week, then reduced to 200 mg twice daily for another week. 
Maintenance dose, usually 200 mg daily or the minimum required to control the arrhythmia.

atcCategory: Nervous System - Psycholeptics
indications: Treatment of psychoses, particularly acute or chronic schizophrenia disorders characterized by positive symptoms(e.g. delusion, hallucinations, thought disorders) and/or negative symptoms(e.g. blunted emotions, emotional and social withdrawal) including when the negative symptoms predominate
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to amisulpride, pheochromocytoma, prolactinomas and breast cancer, pregnancy, lactation, children under 15 years of age

standardDosage.adult: Predominantly negative episodes: 50-300 mg once daily adjusted according to the patient's response. Mixed episodes with positive and negative symptoms: 400-800 mg/day in 2 divided doses adjusted according to the patient's response. Should be taken on an empty stomach (Preferably taken before meals)
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos neurologi/psikiatri pediatrik adalah berasaskan berat badan (mg/kg/hari) dalam dos terbahagi, dimulakan pada dos rendah dan dititrasi setiap minggu. Pemantauan TDM disyorkan untuk Phenytoin, Carbamazepine, Valproate, dan Phenobarbitone.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos normal.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Kurangkan dos harian sebanyak 25 - 50% untuk ubat yang dikumuhkan secara renal (contoh: Levetiracetam, Gabapentin, Pregabalin).
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Berikan dos tambahan selepas setiap sesi dialisis.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Kepekaan tinggi terhadap kesan sedatif dan antikolinergik (kekeliruan, ataksia, risiko jatuh). Mulakan dengan 1/3 hingga 1/2 dos dewasa dan titrasi secara perlahan.

sideEffects: Insomnia, anxiety, agitation, extrapyramidal symptoms, galactorrhea, gynecomastia, amenorrhea, breast pain, impotence, gastrointestinal disorder, weight gain
cautionsAndWarnings: Renal insufficiency (dose reductions), epilepsy, Parkinson's disease; concomitant use of dopamine agonists, previous hypersensitivity to other benzamide derivatives (sulpiride, metoclopramide, tiapride, sultopride), elderly patients (increased risk of adverse effects; reduced renal function may be present requiring dose adjustment), coadministration with other agents which depress the central nervous system or lower blood pressure

atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Antineoplastic Agents
indications: i) To be used when conventional anti-rejection therapy is not successful
ii) Treatment of aplastic anaemia not responding to oxymethalone after 3 months, in which there is persistent pancytopenia with repeated attacks of septicaemia and bleeding.
iii) Severe aplastic anaemia with the following parameters:
a) Granulocyte less than 0.5x109/L
b) Platelet less than 20x109/L
c) Reticulocyte less than 20x109/L
iv) As a conditioning regime prior to transplant.
v) Graft-versus-host disease treatment
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, acute viral illness.

standardDosage.adult: 10 - 30 mg/kg body weight daily. Slow IV infusion (over at least 4 hours) diluted in 250 - 500 ml Normal Saline. For Graft versus host disease treatment:40 mg/kg/day

atcCategory: Blood and Blood Forming Organs - Antithrombotic Agents
indications: i) Prevention of stroke and systemic embolism in adult patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation (NVAF), with one or more risk factors, such as prior stroke or transient ischaemic attack (TIA); age ≥ 75 years; hypertension; diabetes mellitus; symptomatic heart failure (NYHA Class ≥ II)
ii) Treatment of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE), and prevention of recurrent DVT and PE in adults for haemodynamically unstable PE patients.
contraindications: - Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients.
- Active clinically significant active bleeding.
- Hepatic disease associated with coagulopathy and clinically relevant bleeding risk

- Lesion or condition at significant risk of major bleeding such as current or recent gastrointestinal ulceration, presence of malignant neoplasms at high risk of bleeding, recent brain or spinal injury, recent brain, spinal or ophthalmic surgery, recent intracranial haemorrhage, known or suspected oesophageal varices, arteriovenous malformations, vascular aneurysms or major intraspinal or intracerebral vascular abnormalities.

- Concomitant treatment with any other anticoagulant agent e.g. unfractionated heparin (UHF), low molecular weight heparins (enoxaparin, dalteparin, etc.), heparin derivatives (fondaparinux, etc.), oral anticoagulants (warfarin, rivaroxaban, dabigatran, etc.) except under the circumstances of switching anticoagulant therapy or when UHF is given at doses necessary to maintain a patent central venous or arterial catheter.

standardDosage.adult:
i) 5 mg taken orally twice daily. Dose reduction: 2.5mg taken orally twice daily in NVAF patients with at least two of the following characteristics: age ≥80 years old, body weight≤60kg, or serum creatinine≥1.5mg/dL (133micromole/L)
ii) For treatment of acute DVT and PE
10 mg twice daily for the first 7 days (max. 20mg daily) followed by 5mg twice daily (max. 10mg daily)

For prevention of recurrent DVT and PE
2.5mg twice daily (max. 5mg daily) following completion of 6 months of treatment with apixaban 5 mg twice daily or with another anticoagulant
standardDosage.pediatric: Antikoagulasi pediatrik diawasi ketat oleh Pakar Hematologi Pediatrik mengikut Protokol KKM. Enoxaparin rawatan: Neonates 1.5 - 2.0 mg/kg SC Q12H; Kanak-kanak 1.0 mg/kg SC Q12H (Sasaran Anti-Xa: 0.5 - 1.0 unit/mL). Warfarin: Pemula 0.1 - 0.2 mg/kg PO OD (Sasaran INR 2.0 - 3.0).
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos normal.
• CrCl 30 - 50 mL/min: Enoxaparin dos normal atau kurangkan pada warga emas; DOAC kurangkan dos.
• CrCl < 30 mL/min: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC sekali sehari (OD); DOAC adalah KONTRAINDIKASI / ELAKKAN; Warfarin / Heparin Tidak Terpecah (UFH) lebih diutamakan.
• Hemodialisis: UFH semasa sesi dialisis.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Risiko pendarahan tinggi (Skor HAS-BLED). Pantau risiko jatuh, pendarahan saluran gastrousus tersembunyi, dan pendarahan intrakranial.

sideEffects: Eye haemorrhage (including conjunctiva haemorrhage), haemorrhage, haematoma, epistaxis, nausea, gastrointestinal haemorrhage, rectal haemorrhage and gingival bleeding, haematuria, confusion.
NPRA Safety Alert
Risk of Abnormal Uterine Bleeding
cautionsAndWarnings: - Haemorrhage risk.
- Interaction with other medicinal products affecting haemostasis.
- Use of thromboprophylactic agents for the treatment of acute ischemic stroke.
- Patients with prosthetic heart valves.
- Surgery and invasive procedures.
- Temporary discontinuation.
- Spinal/epidural anaesthesia or puncture.
- Renal impairment.
- Body weight.
- Elderly patients.
- Renal impairment.
- Hepatic impairment.
- Interaction with inhibitors of both CYP3A4 and P-gp.
- Interaction with inducers of both CYP3A4 and P-gp.
- Hip fracture surgery.
- Laboratory parameters (Changes observed in clotting test at the expected therapeutic dose are small and subject to a high degree of variability).
- Information about excipients (apixaban contains lactose. Patients with rare hereditary problems of galactose).
NPRA Safety Alert
Risk of Atraumatic Splenic Rupture

interactions.interactingDrug: Ubat Nefrotoksik / Hepatotoksik / Dimetabolismekan oleh CYP450
interactions.effect:
- Inhibitors of CYP3A4 and P-gp such as azoleantimycotics (e.g., ketoconazole, itraconazole, voriconazole and posaconazole) and HIV protease inhibitors (e.g., ritonavir).
- Inducers of CYP3A4 and P-gp (e.g., phenytoin, carbamazepine, phenobarbital or St. John's Wort).
- Anticoagulants, platelet aggregation inhibitors and NSAIDs.
- Activated charcoal.

atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Immunosuppressants
indications: Treatment of adult patients with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis who are candidates for phototherapy or systemic therapy.
contraindications: In patients with known hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients; during pregnancy and in nursing women.
psxRestrictions: As a second line treatment option in patients who have contraindications/treatment goals not achieved/adverse events to methotrexate.

standardDosage.adult: 30mg twice daily taken orally approximately 12 hours apart.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos pada bayi dan kanak-kanak wajib dihitung berdasarkan berat badan (mg/kg) mengikut garis panduan Formulari Pediatrik KKM. Rundingan pakar disyorkan untuk penggunaan luar label atau neonat.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos standard.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Gangguan sederhana — pertimbangkan pengurangan dos 25-50% atau panjangkan selang pemberian.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Gangguan teruk — titrasi berhati-hati dengan pemantauan klinikal dan makmal.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Mulakan pada julat dos terendah (50% daripada dos pemula dewasa standard) dan titrasi secara perlahan dengan pemantauan fungsi buah pinggang dan kognitif.

sideEffects: Diarrhoea and nausea, upper respiratory tract infections, headache, and tension headache, psychiatric disorder, body weight loss.
cautionsAndWarnings: Paediatric use, use in the elderly, weight decrease, diarrhea, nausea and vomiting, depression, renal function and use in patients with lactose intolerance.

atcCategory: Nervous System - Psycholeptics
indications: i) Treatment of acute episodes of schizophrenia and for maintenance of clinical improvement during continuation therapy.
ii) Treatment of acute manic episodes associated with bipolar I disorder
contraindications: Patients who are hypersensitive to aripiprazole or to any of the excipients.

standardDosage.adult: Schizophrenia: 10 or 15 mg/day. Maintenance dose: 15 mg/day. Bipolar mania: Starting dose: 15 or 30 mg/day. Dose adjustment should occur at intervals of not less than 24 hour
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos neurologi/psikiatri pediatrik adalah berasaskan berat badan (mg/kg/hari) dalam dos terbahagi, dimulakan pada dos rendah dan dititrasi setiap minggu. Pemantauan TDM disyorkan untuk Phenytoin, Carbamazepine, Valproate, dan Phenobarbitone.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos normal.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Kurangkan dos harian sebanyak 25 - 50% untuk ubat yang dikumuhkan secara renal (contoh: Levetiracetam, Gabapentin, Pregabalin).
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Berikan dos tambahan selepas setiap sesi dialisis.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Kepekaan tinggi terhadap kesan sedatif dan antikolinergik (kekeliruan, ataksia, risiko jatuh). Mulakan dengan 1/3 hingga 1/2 dos dewasa dan titrasi secara perlahan.

sideEffects: Insomnia, restlessness, headache, dizziness, akathisia, somnolence, sedation, tremor, extrapyramidal disorder, blurred vision, tachycardia, orthostatic hypotension, nausea, vomiting, constipation, dyspepsia, asthenia/fatigue, weight gain, anxiety diabetic ketoacidosis , neuroleptic malignant syndrome, seizure, peripheral oedema
cautionsAndWarnings: Suicide, tardive dyskinesia, neuroleptic malignant syndrome, seizure disorder, diabetes mellitus, CV disease, cerebrovascular disease, dementia-related psychosis and CV adverse events in elderly. May disrupt body's ability to increase/reduce core body temperature. Dysphagia, pregnancy & lactation. May impair ability to drive or operate machinery. Safety and efficacy have not been established in children less than 13 years of age

atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Antineoplastic Agents
indications: Relapsed acute promyelocytic leukaemia (APML).
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to arsenic.
psxRestrictions: To be prescribed by consultant haematologist only.

standardDosage.adult:
Induction : 0.15 mg/kg/day IV until bone marrow remission. Total induction dose ≤ 60 doses. 
Consolidation : 0.15 mg/kg/day IV for 25 doses in 5 weeks (5 days per week, followed by 2 days interruption; treatment should begin 3-6 weeks after completion of induction therapy).
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos kemoterapi dalam pediatrik adalah berasaskan protokol ketat dihitung menggunakan Luas Permukaan Badan (mg/m²) atau berat (mg/kg) mengikut Protokol Onkologi Pediatrik Malaysia (MASPO / SIOP). Memerlukan pengesahan bebas dua pegawai farmasi onkologi.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: 100% dos protokol.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Pengurangan dos mengikut protokol onkologi khusus (biasanya pengurangan 25-50% untuk Cisplatin, Carboplatin, Methotrexate, Capecitabine).
• CrCl < 10 mL/min: Semakan ketat Pakar Onkologi.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Nilai status prestasi (ECOG / Indeks Frailty), rizab sumsum tulang, dan fungsi renal sebelum setiap kitaran rawatan.

sideEffects: Leukocytosis, gastrointestinal symptoms (nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain), fatigue, edema, hyperglycemia, dyspnea, cough, rash or itching, headaches, and dizziness, complete atrioventricular block, prolonged QT interval, Torsades de pointes, ventricular arrhythmia, anemia grade 3 & 4, disseminated intravascular coagulation grade 3 & 4, febrile neutropenia, neutropenia, grade 3 & 4, thrombocytopenia, grade 3 & 4, hepatotoxicity, immune hypersensitivity reaction, renal failure, renal impairment, pleural effusion, retinoic acid - acute promyelocytic leukemia syndrome
cautionsAndWarnings: Hepatic impairment. Severe renal impairment (CrCl less than 30 mL/min), higher exposure, dose reduction may be necessary. APL differentiation syndrome. ECG abnormalities, electrolyte imbalance, hyperleukocytosis, AV block. Pregnancy and lactation. Monitoring requirement: i) FBC daily for first 2 weeks then on alternate days during induction and weekly during consolidation ii) Coagulation profile on alternate days for the first 2 weeks then weekly during induction phase iii) Liver function test, electrolytes twice a week during induction then weekly during consolidation iv) ECG pretreatment and when clinically indicated.

interactions.interactingDrug: Ubat Nefrotoksik / Hepatotoksik / Dimetabolismekan oleh CYP450
interactions.effect: Caution if co-administered with medications that prolong QT interval or lead to electrolyte abnormalities

atcCategory: Sensory Organs - Ophthalmologicals
indications: Moisturizes the ocular surface and provides soothing relief from symptoms associated with dry, irritated eyes.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity

standardDosage.adult: Apply a small amount into the eye. Refer product information leaflet.
standardDosage.pediatric: Topikal & Oftalmik: Sapukan lapisan nipis pada kawasan terjejas 1-2 kali sehari. Pada bayi, elakkan kortikosteroid topikal berpotensi tinggi pada kawasan permukaan luas atau di bawah lampin kerana penyerapan sistemik dan penindasan paksi HPA.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:

sideEffects: Temporary visual disturbance
cautionsAndWarnings: Do not use if allergic to any of the ingredients

atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Antineoplastic Agents
indications: Asciminib is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with Philadelphia chromosome-positive chronic myeloid leukaemia in chronic phase (Ph+ CML-CP) previously treated with two or more tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
contraindications: None.
psxRestrictions:
i.	As a third line treatment for adult Ph+ CML-CP patients with pre-existing CV risks and/or CV events.
ii.	To be prescribed by Haematologist only.

standardDosage.adult: 40 mg twice daily at approximately 12‐hour intervals.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos kemoterapi dalam pediatrik adalah berasaskan protokol ketat dihitung menggunakan Luas Permukaan Badan (mg/m²) atau berat (mg/kg) mengikut Protokol Onkologi Pediatrik Malaysia (MASPO / SIOP). Memerlukan pengesahan bebas dua pegawai farmasi onkologi.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: 100% dos protokol.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Pengurangan dos mengikut protokol onkologi khusus (biasanya pengurangan 25-50% untuk Cisplatin, Carboplatin, Methotrexate, Capecitabine).
• CrCl < 10 mL/min: Semakan ketat Pakar Onkologi.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Nilai status prestasi (ECOG / Indeks Frailty), rizab sumsum tulang, dan fungsi renal sebelum setiap kitaran rawatan.

sideEffects: Musculoskeletal pain, upper respiratory tract infections, thrombocytopaenia, fatigue, headache, arthralgia, rash, increased pancreatic enzymes, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, nausea, neutropenia, hypertension, anaemia, cardiac failure congestive, lower respiratory tract infections, pyrexia, pancreatitis, mesenteric artery thrombosis and ischemic stroke.
cautionsAndWarnings: Myelosuppression, pancreatic toxicity, cardiovascular toxicity, hypertension, hypersensitivity, embryo-fetal toxicity.

interactions.interactingDrug: Ubat Nefrotoksik / Hepatotoksik / Dimetabolismekan oleh CYP450
interactions.effect: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (clarithromycin, itraconazole), CYP3A4 substrates (midazolam), CYP2C9 substrates (warfarin), substrates of OATP1B or BCRP (atorvastatin, rosuvastatin).

storageConditions.specialStorageNote: Simpan dalam bekas asal yang bertutup rapat pada suhu bilik terkawal (<30°C). Lindungi daripada cahaya matahari terus dan kelembapan.

inUseStabilityNotes.blisterPackStability: Kekal stabil sehingga tarikh luput pengilang selagi pek lepuh (blister foil) tidak pecah atau berlubang.
inUseStabilityNotes.looseBottleStability: Gunakan dalam tempoh 6 bulan selepas penutup botol dibuka (atau sehingga tarikh luput asal, yang mana lebih awal).

shelfLife.multiDoseVialPolicy: Guna Dalam 6 Bulan Selepas Buka Botol (Pek Botol)

atcCategory: Alimentary Tract and Metabolism - Vitamins
indications: Vitamin C deficiency
contraindications: History of hyperoxaluria

standardDosage.adult: ADULT: 100-250 mg once or twice daily CHILD: 100 mg three times daily for one week followed by 100mg daily until symptoms abate.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos pada bayi dan kanak-kanak wajib dihitung berdasarkan berat badan (mg/kg) mengikut garis panduan Formulari Pediatrik KKM. Rundingan pakar disyorkan untuk penggunaan luar label atau neonat.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos standard.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Gangguan sederhana — pertimbangkan pengurangan dos 25-50% atau panjangkan selang pemberian.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Gangguan teruk — titrasi berhati-hati dengan pemantauan klinikal dan makmal.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Mulakan pada julat dos terendah (50% daripada dos pemula dewasa standard) dan titrasi secara perlahan dengan pemantauan fungsi buah pinggang dan kognitif.

sideEffects: In large doses, gastrointestinal disturbances, renal calcium oxalate calculi formation
cautionsAndWarnings: Use cautiously in patients with preexisting kidney stone disease, erythrocyte G6PD deficiency, haemochromatosis, thalassaemia or sideroblastic anaemia and avoid rapid intravenous injections

atcCategory: Nervous System - Psycholeptics
indications: For second or third line treatment in adult for:
i) Schizophrenia

ii) Bipolar Disorder - Monotherapy: Acute treatment of manic or mixed episodes associated with Bipolar I disorder. - Adjunctive therapy: As adjunctive therapy with either lithium or valproate for the acute treatment of manic or mixed episodes associated with Bipolar I Disorder.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to asenapine.

standardDosage.adult:
i) Schizophrenia: - Acute treatment in adults: Recommended starting and target dose of asenapine is 5mg given twice daily. - Maintenance dose: 5mg twice daily. 

ii) Bipolar Disorder: - Monotherapy: 10mg twice daily. Adjunctive therapy: 5mg twice daily with lithium or valproate. Dose can be increased to 10mg twice daily based on clinical response.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos neurologi/psikiatri pediatrik adalah berasaskan berat badan (mg/kg/hari) dalam dos terbahagi, dimulakan pada dos rendah dan dititrasi setiap minggu. Pemantauan TDM disyorkan untuk Phenytoin, Carbamazepine, Valproate, dan Phenobarbitone.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos normal.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Kurangkan dos harian sebanyak 25 - 50% untuk ubat yang dikumuhkan secara renal (contoh: Levetiracetam, Gabapentin, Pregabalin).
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Berikan dos tambahan selepas setiap sesi dialisis.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Kepekaan tinggi terhadap kesan sedatif dan antikolinergik (kekeliruan, ataksia, risiko jatuh). Mulakan dengan 1/3 hingga 1/2 dos dewasa dan titrasi secara perlahan.

sideEffects: Akathisia, oral hypoesthesia, somnolence, dizziness, extrapyramidal symptoms other than akathisia, weight gain, dysgeusia, oral hypoesthesia, dystonia.
cautionsAndWarnings: Cerebrovascular adverse events, dementia-related psychosis, neuroleptic malignant syndrome, tardive dyskinesia, hyperglycemia & diabetes mellitus. Monitor weight regularly. Hypersensitivity reaction such as anaphylaxis, angioedema, hypotension, tachycardia, swollen tongue, dyspnea, wheezing and rash. Orthostatic hypotension, syncope & other hemodynamic effects. genericName: Atazanavir 300mg and Ritonavir 100mg Film Coated Tablet
atcCategory: Antiinfectives for Systemic Use - Antivirals for Systemic Use
indications: Treatment of HIV-1 infected, antiretroviral treatment experienced adults, in combination with other antiretroviral medicinal products.
contraindications: Atazanavir/ritonavir is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to its active substances or excipients, and in individuals with moderate to severe hepatic insufficiency. Co-administration is contraindicated with St. John’s wort (Hypericum perforatum), hepatitis C therapeutics containing grazoprevir (e.g., elbasvir/grazoprevir) or glecaprevir/pibrentasvir, and medications products that are highly dependent on CYP3A for clearance due to the risk of serious or life-threatening adverse events.
psxRestrictions: For Infectious Disease Physicians use, in patients with treatment failure on NNRTI regimen.

standardDosage.adult: One tablet (Atazanavir 300mg and Ritonavir 100mg) taken orally once daily with food.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos pediatrik dihitung mengikut berat badan (mg/kg/dos) per indikasi klinikal FUKKM. Bagi neonat (<28 hari), dos diselaraskan mengikut berat lahir dan umur gestasi.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos penuh normal.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Kurangkan dos harian sebanyak 50% atau panjangkan selang dos.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min: Selang masa Q24H - Q48H.
• Hemodialisis: Berikan dos tambahan selepas dialisis.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Pantau fungsi renal dan toleransi sistem saraf pusat.

sideEffects: Commonly reported adverse drug reactions include the gastrointestinal system (diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, dyspepsia, and abdominal pain), the nervous system (headache, dizziness, dysgeusia, and peripheral or oral paraesthesia), and general asthenia or fatigue. Other highly prevalent clinical effects include respiratory symptoms (pharyngitis, cough), musculoskeletal pain (arthralgia, back pain, myalgia), and dermatological reactions (pruritus, maculopapular rash). Patients also commonly experience metabolic and haematological shifts, such as hyperlipidaemia, dehydration, and thrombocytopenia, alongside hepatobiliary complications including jaundice, hepatitis, and elevated blood bilirubin.
cautionsAndWarnings: Monitor liver function closely, particularly in patients with chronic hepatitis B or C, due to the elevated risk of severe hepatic reactions. Reversible hyperbilirubinemia is common; however, dose reduction is not recommended, and co-administration with indinavir is contraindicated. Cardiac monitoring is advised due to potential PR and QT interval prolongations, especially in patients with pre-existing conduction abnormalities or structural heart disease. Regular renal monitoring is required given the risks of chronic kidney disease and nephrolithiasis; this regimen is not recommended for patients undergoing haemodialysis. Therapy must be discontinued immediately if severe skin reactions (e.g., Stevens-Johnson syndrome, DRESS) or pancreatitis develop. Additional clinical monitoring is warranted for cholelithiasis, metabolic shifts (blood glucose, lipids, weight), and diarrhoea, which may compromise drug absorption. Clinicians should also assess for Immune Reactivation Syndrome, osteonecrosis, and increased bleeding episodes in haemophiliac patients.

interactions.interactingDrug: Ubat Nefrotoksik / Hepatotoksik / Dimetabolismekan oleh CYP450
interactions.effect: As a potent CYP3A inhibitor, ritonavir can substantially increase plasma concentrations of concurrently administered CYP3A-metabolized drugs (particularly those with high first-pass metabolism), which can lead to fatal toxicities (e.g., when combined with sedative-hypnotics, antiarrhythmics, or ergot alkaloids). Conversely, co-administration with CYP3A4 inducers or inhibitors may significantly alter atazanavir and ritonavir levels, resulting in either heightened drug toxicity or subtherapeutic exposure, which risks a loss of therapeutic efficacy and the development of viral resistance.

cautionsAndWarnings: Co-administration of atazanavir with ritonavir at doses greater than 100 mg once daily has not been evaluated. The use of higher ritonavir doses may alter the safety profile of atazanavir (cardiac effects, hyperbilirubinaemia) and therefore is not recommended. Only when atazanavir with ritonavir is co-administered with efavirenz, a dose increase of ritonavir to 200 mg once daily could be considered. In this instance, close clinical monitoring is warranted.
Patients with coexisting conditions: Hepatic impairment; liver dysfunction; renal impairment; QT prolongation; haemophiliac patients.
Fat redistribution and metabolic disorders: redistribution of body fat (lipodystrophy) in HIV patients; dyslipidaemia; hyperglycaemia; hyperbilirubinaemia; cholelithiasis; nephrolithiasis.
Immune reactivation syndrome
Osteonecrosis.
Rash and associated syndromes.
Patient with rare hereditary problems of galactose intorelence, the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucosegalactose malabsorption should not take this product.

Nucleoside/nucleotide reverse transcriptase inhibitors (NRTIs); Non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors (NNRTIs); Protease inhibitors.

genericName: Atezolizumab 60mg/ml Concentrate for Solution for Infusion
atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Antineoplastic Agents
indications: Atezolizumab, in combination with Bevacizumab, is indicated for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) who have not received prior systemic therapy
contraindications: Contraindicated in patients with a known hypersensitivity to atezolizumab or any of the excipients
psxRestrictions: Only for patients with Child-Pugh A

standardDosage.adult: The recommended dose of atezolizumab in combination therapy is 1200 mg administered every 3 weeks, all doses administered as IV infusion.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos kemoterapi dalam pediatrik adalah berasaskan protokol ketat dihitung menggunakan Luas Permukaan Badan (mg/m²) atau berat (mg/kg) mengikut Protokol Onkologi Pediatrik Malaysia (MASPO / SIOP). Memerlukan pengesahan bebas dua pegawai farmasi onkologi.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: 100% dos protokol.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Pengurangan dos mengikut protokol onkologi khusus (biasanya pengurangan 25-50% untuk Cisplatin, Carboplatin, Methotrexate, Capecitabine).
• CrCl < 10 mL/min: Semakan ketat Pakar Onkologi.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Nilai status prestasi (ECOG / Indeks Frailty), rizab sumsum tulang, dan fungsi renal sebelum setiap kitaran rawatan.

sideEffects: ADRs identified in clinical trials (not reported in monotherapy trials) associated with the use of atezolizumab in combination therapy:

Anemia, lymphophenia, neutropenia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, constipation, stomatitis, oedema peripheral, lung infection, blood alkaline phosphatase increased, hypomagnesemia, dizziness, dysgeusia, peripheral neuropathy, syncope, proteinuria, dysphonia, nasopharyngitis, alopecia, hypertension
cautionsAndWarnings: Haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, Immune-mediated pneumonitis, Immune-mediated hepatitis, Immune- mediated colitis, Immune-mediated endocrinopathies, Immune-mediated meningoencephalitis, Immune-mediated neuropathies, Immune-mediated pancreatitis, Immune-mediated myocarditis, Immune-mediated myositis, Immune- mediated nephritis, Infusion related reactions, Immune-mediated severe cutaneous adverse reactions, Immune-mediated pericardial disorders, Special populations (e.g. patients with autoimmune disease), embryofoetal toxicity.

interactions.interactingDrug: Ubat Nefrotoksik / Hepatotoksik / Dimetabolismekan oleh CYP450
interactions.effect: No formal pharmacokinetic drug-drug interaction studies have been conducted with atezolizumab. Since atezolizumab is cleared from the circulation through catabolism, no metabolic drug-drug interactions are expected

incompatibleDiluents: Jangan campur bersama ubat IV lain dalam picagari atau tiub infusi yang sama tanpa data keserasian fizikal/kimia.

postDilutionStability.roomTempDuration: Habiskan infusi dalam tempoh 12 hingga 24 jam pada 25°C

cautionsAndWarnings: Hypotension, cardiovascular or cerebrovascular disease. Hypertension tachycardia. Urinary retention or bladder dysfunction. atcCategory: Genito Urinary System and Sex Hormones - Other Gynecologicals
indications: To delay imminent preterm birth in pregnant women with:
i)Regular uterine contractions of at least 30 seconds duration at a rate of ≥ 4 per 30 minutes
ii) A cervical dilation of 1 to 3 cm (0 - 3 nulliparas) and effacement of ≥ 50%
iii) Age ≥ 18 years
iv) A gestational age from 28 until 33 completed weeks
v) A normal foetal heart rate.
contraindications: Gestational age below 28 or over 33 completed wk, premature rupture of the membranes after 30 wk of pregnancy, intrauterine growth retardation or abnormal foetal heart rate, antepartum uterine haemorrhage that requires immediate delivery, eclampsia or severe pre-eclampsia requiring delivery, intrauterine foetal death, suspected intrauterine infection, placenta praevia, abruptio placenta, abnormal or high-risk pregnancy, known hypersensitivity to active substance or excipients.

standardDosage.adult:
Initial intravenous bolus dose of 6.75mg (as 7.5 mg/ml solution)
Immediately followed by a continuous loading intravenous infusion at 18mg/hr for 3 hours and then followed by intravenous infusion at 6mg/hr up to 45 hours. 
 
The total duration of treatment should not exceed 48 hours and the total dose per treatment course should not exceed 330mg of the active substance. 

The dosing is individualized according to product insert / protocol.

sideEffects: Nausea & vomiting, headache, dizziness, hot flushes, tachycardia, hypotension, injection site reactions, hyperglycemia, fever, insomnia, itch, rash, allergic reaction, postpartum bleeding
cautionsAndWarnings: Renal & hepatic dysfunction, abnormally positioned placenta, multiple pregnancy or pregnancy between 24-27 wk, small for gestational age foetus. Dosage for obese patients should be based on ideal body-weight to prevent overdosing.

atcCategory: Alimentary Tract and Metabolism - Drugs for Functional Gastrointestinal Disorders
indications: i) Reduce vagal inhibition,salivary and bronchiol secretion in anaesthesia
ii) Reversal of excessive bradycardia
iii) Reversal of effect of competitive muscle relaxants
iv) Overdosage with other compounds having muscarinic action
v) Organophosphate poisoning
contraindications: Glaucoma, chronic respiratory disease, sick sinus syndrome, thyrotoxicosis, cardiac failure, pyloric stenosis, prostatic hypertrophy.

standardDosage.adult:
i) Adult: 300-600 mcg IM/SC 30-60 minutes before anaesthesia. Alternatively, 300-600 mcg IV immediately before induction of anaesthesia. Child: >20 kg: 300-600 mcg; 12-16 kg: 300 mcg; 7-9 kg: 200 mcg; >3 kg: 100 mcg. Doses to be given via IM/SC admin 30-60 minutes before anaesthesia.
ii) Adult: 500 mcg every 3-5 minutes. Total: 3 mg. Max Dosage: 0.04 mg/kg body weight.
iii) Adult 0.6-1.2 mg before or with anticholinesterase 
iv) Adult: 0.6-1 mg IV/IM/SC, repeated every 2 hr. 
v) Adult: 2 mg IV/IM, every 10-30 minutes until muscarinic effects disappear or atropine toxicity appears. In severe cases, dose can be given as often as every 5 minutes. In moderate to severe poisoning, a state of atropinisation is maintained for at least 2 days and continued for as long as symptoms are present. Child: 20 mcg/kg given every 5-10 minutes.
standardDosage.pediatric: GERD & Penyakit Peptik: Omeprazole 0.7 - 1 mg/kg/hari PO OD. Antispasmodik & Antidiareal: Loperamide adalah KONTRAINDIKASI pada kanak-kanak < 2 tahun. Garam hidrasi oral (ORS) adalah rawatan barisan pertama gastroenteritis akut.

• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Dos normal untuk PPI; antagonis H2 (Famotidine/Ranitidine) memerlukan pengurangan dos 50%.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Semak indikasi PPI secara berkala; henti apabila tidak lagi diperlukan bagi mengurangkan risiko patah tulang dan jangkitan C. difficile.

sideEffects: Dry mouth, dysphagia, constipation, flushing and dryness of skin, tachycardia, palpitations, arrhythmias, mydriasis, photophobia, cycloplegia, raised intraocular pressure. Toxic doses cause tachycardia, hyperpyrexia, restlessness, confusion, excitement, hallucinations, delirium and may progress to circulatory failure and resp depression. Potentially Fatal: Atrial arrhythmias, AV dissociation, multiple ventricular ectopi.
cautionsAndWarnings: Reflux oesophagitis, elderly, infants and children. Pregnancy.

genericName: Azacitidine Powder for suspension for injection 100mg/vial
atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Antineoplastic Agents
indications: First line therapy for intermediate-2 and high risk MDS, CMMOL with 10-29% blasts with no transplant option and elderly AML with 20-30% blasts and multilineage dysplasia.
contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients. Advanced malignant hepatic tumors and lactation.

standardDosage.adult:
Recommended starting dose for the first treatment cycle, for all patients regardless of baseline haematology laboratory values, is 75mg/m2 of body surface area. Injected subcutaneously. 
Daily for 7 days, followed by a rest period of 21 days (28 day treatment cycle).
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos kemoterapi dalam pediatrik adalah berasaskan protokol ketat dihitung menggunakan Luas Permukaan Badan (mg/m²) atau berat (mg/kg) mengikut Protokol Onkologi Pediatrik Malaysia (MASPO / SIOP). Memerlukan pengesahan bebas dua pegawai farmasi onkologi.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: 100% dos protokol.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Pengurangan dos mengikut protokol onkologi khusus (biasanya pengurangan 25-50% untuk Cisplatin, Carboplatin, Methotrexate, Capecitabine).
• CrCl < 10 mL/min: Semakan ketat Pakar Onkologi.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Nilai status prestasi (ECOG / Indeks Frailty), rizab sumsum tulang, dan fungsi renal sebelum setiap kitaran rawatan.

sideEffects: Pneumonia, nasopharyngitis, febrile neutropenia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, anaemia,anorexia, dizziness, headache, dyspnea,diarrhea, vomiting, constipation, nausea, abdominal pain, petechiae, pruritis, rash, ecchymosis, arthralgia, fatigue, pyrexia, chest pain, injection site erythema, injection site pain, injection site reaction
NPRA Safety Alert
Neoplasms benign, malignant and unspecified (including cysts and polyps): Differentiation syndrome
Risk of Cutaneous Vasculitis
cautionsAndWarnings: Patients should be advised to promptly report febrile episodes.
Patients and physicians are also advised to be observant for signs and symptoms of bleeding.
Its also contraindicated in patients with advanced malignant hepatic tumour.
Patients with renal impairment should be closely monitored for toxicity since azacitidine and/or its metabolites are primarily excreted by the kidney.
NPRA Safety Alert
Differentiation syndrome

interactions.interactingDrug: Ubat Nefrotoksik / Hepatotoksik / Dimetabolismekan oleh CYP450
interactions.effect: Based on in vitro data, azacitidine metabolism does not appear to be mediated by cytochrome P450 isoenzymes (CYPs), UDP-glucuronosyltransferases (UGTs), sulfotransferases (SULTs), and glutathionetransferases (GSTs); interactions related to these metabolizing enzymes in vivo are therefore considered unlikely. Clinically significant inhibitory or inductive effects of azacitidine on cytochrome P450 enzymes are unlikely

atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Immunosuppressants
indications: 1. Treatment of moderate to severe active rheumatoid arthritis in adult patients who have responded inadequately to, or who are intolerant to one or more disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drugs. May be
used as monotherapy or in combination with methotrexate.
2. Indicated for the treatment of severe atopic dermatitis in adult patients who are candidates for systemic therapy.
3. Treatment of severe alopecia areata in adult patients.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to the active substances, or to any of the other excipients
psxRestrictions:
Indikasi 1. Severe active rheumatoid arthritis: 
To be prescribed by Rheumatologist only

Indikasi 2. Severe atopic dermatitis: 
i.	As fourth line of treatment in patients who have failed / have contraindications / experienced adverse events to:  
•	Intensive and optimized topical treatment  
•	Phototherapy  
•	At least two immunosuppressants  
ii.	To be prescribed by Dermatologists only.

Indikasi 3. Severe alopecia areata:
i. Reserved for patients who have demonstrated an inadequate therapeutic response, intolerance, or a documented contraindication to first-line conventional systemic therapies, which includes corticosteroids or non-targeted immunosuppressants.
ii. To be prescribed by Dermatologists only.

standardDosage.adult:
Indikasi 1. Severe active rheumatoid arthritis: 
4mg once daily

Indikasi 2. Severe atopic dermatitis: 
The recommended dose of baricitinib is 4 mg once daily with or without food and may be taken at any time of the day. A dose of 2 mg once daily is appropriate for patients such as those aged ≥ 75 years and may be appropriate for patients with a history of chronic or recurrent infections. A dose of 2 mg once daily should be considered for patients who have achieved sustained control of disease activity with 4 mg once daily and are eligible for dose tapering. Baricitinib can be used with or without concomitant topical therapies (Refer package insert)

Indikasi 3. Severe alopecia areata:
Administer 4 mg once daily, tapering to 2 mg for maintenance once sustained control is achieved. Initiate at 2 mg once daily for patients aged ≥ 65 years, those with chronic or recurrent infections, or those at elevated risk for VTE, MACE, or malignancy; this starting dose may be escalated to 4 mg if disease control remains inadequate.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos pada bayi dan kanak-kanak wajib dihitung berdasarkan berat badan (mg/kg) mengikut garis panduan Formulari Pediatrik KKM. Rundingan pakar disyorkan untuk penggunaan luar label atau neonat.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos standard.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Gangguan sederhana — pertimbangkan pengurangan dos 25-50% atau panjangkan selang pemberian.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Gangguan teruk — titrasi berhati-hati dengan pemantauan klinikal dan makmal.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Mulakan pada julat dos terendah (50% daripada dos pemula dewasa standard) dan titrasi secara perlahan dengan pemantauan fungsi buah pinggang dan kognitif.

sideEffects: Upper respiratory tract infections, hypercholesterolaemia, herpes zoster, herpes simplex, gastroenteritis, urinary tract infections, pneumonia, folliculitis, thrombocytosis >600 x 109 cells/L, headache, nausea, abdominal pain, ALT increased ≥3X upper limit normal (ULN), rash, acne, creatinine phosphokinase increased >5 x ULN.
cautionsAndWarnings: Infections, tuberculosis, haematological abnormalities, viral reactivation, vaccination, lipids, hepatic transaminase elevations, malignancy, venous thromboembolism, major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), immunosuppressive medicinal products, hypersensitivity, diverticulitis, renal impairment, hepatic impairment, elderly, women of childbearing potential, breast-feeding.

interactions.effect: Immunosuppressants such as azathioprine, tacrolimus or ciclosporin, probenecid, leflunomide, teriflunomide, ibuprofen, diclofenac.

i) Maintenance therapy (taken as regular maintenance treatment with a separate as needed rapid-acting bronchodilator):
Dose recommendations for adults 18 years and above: One or two inhalations twice daily. The maximum daily dose is 4 inhalations.
ii) Maintenance and reliever therapy (taken as regular maintenance treatment and as needed in response to asthma symptoms):
Dose recommendations for adults 18 years and above: The recommended maintenance dose is 1 inhalation twice daily (one inhalation in the morning and one inhalation in the evening). Patients should take 1 additional inhalation as needed in response to symptoms. If symptoms persist after a few minutes, an additional inhalation should be taken. The maximum daily dose is 8 inhalations.

For COPD:
2 puffs two times a day.

atcCategory: Antiinfectives for Systemic Use - Antimycobacterials
indications: Indicated for use as part of an appropriate combination regimen for pulmonary multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (MDR-TB) in adult patients when an effective treatment regimen cannot otherwise be composed for reasons of resistance or tolerability. Consideration should be given to official guidance on the appropriate use of antibacterial agents.
contraindications: Hear failure, QT interval as corrected by the Fridericia method (QTcF) > 450ms (confirmed by repeat electrocardiogram), family history of congenital QT prolongation, history of or ongoing hypothyroidism, a history of or ongoing bradyarrhythmia, a history of Torsade de Pointes, concomitant administration of fluoroquinolones antibiotics that have a potential for significant QT prolongation (i.e., gatifloxacin, moxifloxacin and sparfloxacin), and hypokalemia.

genericName: Bendamustine Hydrochloride 100mg/vial powder for concentrate for solution for infusion
atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Antineoplastic Agents
dosageForms: Hydrochloride 100mg/vial powder for concentrate for solution for infusion
indications: Bendamustine is indicated for monotherapy in patients with indolent B-cell non-Hodgkin's lymphomas (iNHL) that has progressed during or within six months of treatment with rituximab or a rituximab-containing regimen.
contraindications: - Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients.
- During breast-feeding.
- Severe hepatic impairment (serum bilirubin > 3.0 mg/dL).
- Jaundice.
- Severe bone marrow suppression and severe blood count alterations (leukocyte and/or platelet values dropped to < 3000/μL or < 75000/μL, respectively).
- Major surgery less than 30 days before start of treatment.
- Infections, especially involving leukocytopenia.
- Yellow fever vaccination.

standardDosage.adult: Monotherapy for iNHL refractory to rituximab: 120mg/m2 body surface area bendamustine hydrochloride on days 1 and 2; every 3 weeks.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos kemoterapi dalam pediatrik adalah berasaskan protokol ketat dihitung menggunakan Luas Permukaan Badan (mg/m²) atau berat (mg/kg) mengikut Protokol Onkologi Pediatrik Malaysia (MASPO / SIOP). Memerlukan pengesahan bebas dua pegawai farmasi onkologi.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: 100% dos protokol.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Pengurangan dos mengikut protokol onkologi khusus (biasanya pengurangan 25-50% untuk Cisplatin, Carboplatin, Methotrexate, Capecitabine).
• CrCl < 10 mL/min: Semakan ketat Pakar Onkologi.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Nilai status prestasi (ECOG / Indeks Frailty), rizab sumsum tulang, dan fungsi renal sebelum setiap kitaran rawatan.

sideEffects: Common: Haematological adverse reactions (leukopenia, thrombopenia), dermatologic toxicities (allergic reactions), constitutional symptoms (fever), gastrointestinal symptoms (nausea, vomiting).
cautionsAndWarnings: There are insufficient data from the use of bendamustine in pregnant women. In nonclinical studies bendamustine hydrochloride was embryo-/fetolethal, teratogenic and genotoxic. During pregnancy bendamustine should not be used unless clearly necessary. It is not known whether bendamustine passes into the breast milk, therefore, bendamustine is contraindicated during breast-feeding. Breast-feeding must be discontinued during treatment with bendamustine. No studies on the effects on the ability to drive and use machines have been performed. However, ataxia, peripheral neuropathy and somnolence have been reported during treatment with bendamustine. Patients should be instructed that if they experience these symptoms they should avoid potentially hazardous tasks such as driving and using machines.
NPRA Safety Alert (6 Okt 2017)
- Increased Mortality Observed When Used in Non-approved Combination Treatments or Outside the Approved Indications

interactions.interactingDrug: Ubat Nefrotoksik / Hepatotoksik / Dimetabolismekan oleh CYP450
interactions.effect:
- Combination of bendamustine with cyclosporine or tacrolimus may result in excessive immunosuppression with risk of lymphoproliferation. 
- Bendamustine metabolism involves cytochrome P450 (CYP) 1A2 isoenzyme. Therefore, the potential for interaction with CYP1A2 inhibitors such as fluvoxamine, ciprofloxacin, acyclovir and cimetidine exists.

incompatibleDiluents: Jangan campur bersama ubat IV lain dalam picagari atau tiub infusi yang sama tanpa data keserasian fizikal/kimia.

storageConditions.specialStorageNote: Simpan pada suhu bilik terkawal (<30°C). Lindungi daripada cahaya matahari terus.

postReconstitutionStability.roomTempDuration: Gunakan dalam 6 hingga 24 jam pada suhu 25°C

postDilutionStability.roomTempDuration: Habiskan infusi dalam tempoh 12 hingga 24 jam pada 25°C

shelfLife.multiDoseVialPolicy: Single Use Only - Discard Remainder

indications: i) Infections caused by susceptible organisms.

standardDosage.adult: i) Adult: 600mg - 3600mg (1 - 6 mega units) daily, divided into 4 to 6 doses. Higher doses (24 mega units) in divided doses may be given in serious infections such as meningitis. Child 1 month to 12 years old: 100mg/kg/day in 4 divided doses, not exceeding 4g/day; Infants 1 -4 weeks: 75mg/kg/day in 3 divided doses; Newborn Infants: 50mg/kg/day in 2 divided doses ii)7.2 to 12g (12 - 20 mega units) maybe given daily in divided doses

cautionsAndWarnings: Very high doses in poor renal function (risk of neurotoxicity) or heart failure. Avoid contact, skin sensitization may occur. Monitor serum potassium concentration, renal and haematological status.
