atcCategory: Antiinfectives for Systemic Use - Antivirals for Systemic Use
indications: Prescriber Category A*:
i. Treatment of HIV-1 infected adults in combination with other antiretroviral agents.
ii. Use as first line monotherapy for chronic hepatitis B or as a rescue therapy for patients with drug resistance hepatitis B virus (according to resistant profile or treatment guidelines).
Prescriber Category A/KK:
iii. For antenatal patients only with chronic Hepatitis B with HBeAg reactive or HBV DNA more than 200,000 or deranged LFT.
iv. For adult patients with chronic Hepatitis B (CHB) eAg positive or eAg negative chronic hepatitis
contraindications: Lactation. Do not co-administer with fixed dose combinations containing tenofovir.
psxRestrictions:
Indication iv: 
For non-cirrhotic liver disease only.

standardDosage.adult:
Indication i, ii & iv:
300mg once daily. 

Renal Dose Adjustment: 
300mg every 48hours (30-49ml/min); 
300mg every 72hours (10-29ml/min); 
300mg every 7 days after dialysis (Hemodialysis).

Indication iii:
300mg once daily from 28 weeks of gestation and continue till 4 weeks postpartum
standardDosage.pediatric:
Kanak-kanak ≥ 2 tahun (Berat ≥ 10 kg):
• 10 hingga <14 kg: 100 mg PO OD.
• 14 hingga <17 kg: 150 mg PO OD.
• 17 hingga <22 kg: 200 mg PO OD.
• 22 hingga <28 kg: 250 mg PO OD.
• Berat ≥ 28 kg: 300 mg PO OD (Dos dewasa).
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos penuh normal.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Kurangkan dos harian sebanyak 50% atau panjangkan selang dos.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min: Selang masa Q24H - Q48H.
• Hemodialisis: Berikan dos tambahan selepas dialisis.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Pantau fungsi renal dan toleransi sistem saraf pusat.

sideEffects: Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, flatulence, dyspepsia, anorexia, skin rash, peripheral neuropathy, headache, dizziness, insomnia, depression, dyspnoea, asthenia, sweating, myalgia, myopathy, body fat redistribution, osteomalacia. Hypophosphataemia, raised amylase and liver enzymes, hepatitis, hypertriglyceridaemia, hyperglycaemia, neutropenia, nephritis, nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, renal impairment, proximal tubulopathy, Fanconi syndrome, immune reconstitution syndrome. Potentially Fatal: Lactic acidosis with severe hepatomegaly with steatosis; severe acute exacerbations of hepatitis B. Acute renal failure.
cautionsAndWarnings: Renal impairment. Hepatomegaly or at risk for liver disease. Elderly and pregnancy. Discontinue therapy if there is a rapid rise in aminotransferase concentrations, progressive hepatomegaly or steatosis, metabolic or lactic acidosis of unknown cause. Monitor creatinine clearance and serum phosphorus routinely in patients at risk of renal impairment. Bone monitoring for patients with history of pathologic bone fracture or at risk of osteopenia. Test for presence of chronic hepatitis b virus (HBV) before initiating therapy. If tenofovir is discontinued in patients co-infected with HIV and HBV, monitor hepatic function for several month for exacerbation of hepatitis. Monitor child exposed in utero to combination drug for possible mitochondrial dysfunction.

interactions.interactingDrug: Decreased atazanavir concentration with tenofovir unless also co-administered with ritonavir. Increased serum concentration of tenofovir or co-administered drug if taken with drugs that are eliminated by active tubular secretion.Potentially Fatal
interactions.effect: Decreased atazanavir concentration with tenofovir unless also co-administered with ritonavir. Increased serum concentration of tenofovir or co-administered drug if taken with drugs that are eliminated by active tubular secretion.Potentially Fatal: Increased risk of renal impairment with recent or concurrent use of nephrotoxic agents (e.g. aminoglycosides, amphotericin B, foscarnet, ganciclovir, pentamidine, vancomycin, cidofovir or interleukin-2); monitor renal function wkly if unavoidable. Increased didanosine levels and thereby increasing risk of pancreatitis and peripheral neuropathy, with a high treatment failure rate with concurrent use; avoid concurrent use.

dosageForms: Disoproxil Fumarate 300mg, Emtricitabine 200mg & Efavirenz 600mg Tablets (Fixed-dose combination)
indications: Indicated for the treatment of HIV-1 infection in adults
contraindications: Contraindicated in patients with previously demonstrated hypersensitivity to any of the components of the product. Drugs that are contraindicated or not recommended for use with this fixed-dose combination include:

• Antimigraine: Ergot derivatives (dihydroergotamine, ergonovine, ergotamine, methylergonovine)
• Benzodiazepines: midazolam, triazolam

• GI motility agent: cisapride
• Neuroleptic: pimozide

sideEffects: Efavirenz (EFV) induced CNS neuropsychiatric manifestations (e.g. headache, disturbance in attention, abnormal dreams, somnolence, insomnia, depression (severe in 1.6%), and anxiety), kidney function decline or failure and bone abnormalities.
cautionsAndWarnings: - Should be taken cautiously in patients with bone, kidney or liver problems in anamnesis as well as in patients with psychiatric disorders and addictions.

- Particular caution should be exercised in patients coinfected with HIV-1 and HBV. Other more specific precaution include nervous system symptoms, rash, convulsions, immune reconstitution syndrome and fat redistribution.
- Drug should not be used during pregnancy unless clearly necessary, moreover pregnancy should be avoided in women receiving this fixed-dose combination.

standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos standard.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Gangguan sederhana — pertimbangkan pengurangan dos 25-50% atau panjangkan selang pemberian.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Gangguan teruk — titrasi berhati-hati dengan pemantauan klinikal dan makmal.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Mulakan pada julat dos terendah (50% daripada dos pemula dewasa standard) dan titrasi secara perlahan dengan pemantauan fungsi buah pinggang dan kognitif.

sideEffects: Tachycardia, dizziness, syncope, headache and asthenia, nasal congestion, drowsiness, nausea, peripheral edema, postural hypotension.
cautionsAndWarnings: Carcinoma of the prostate and benign prostatic hyperplasia may cause the same symptoms. Prostate cancer should be ruled out prior to treatment. Dizziness, lightheadedness, orthostatic hypotension, syncope (first-dose effect). Patients advised to avoid driving or doing hazardous tasks for the first 12 hours after the initial dose or when dose is increased.

Mulakan pada julat dos terendah (50% daripada dos pemula dewasa standard) dan titrasi secara perlahan dengan pemantauan fungsi buah pinggang dan kognitif.

sideEffects: Diarrhoea, nausea; alopecia; increased alanine aminotransferase. Influenza, upper respiratory tract infection, UTI, bronchitis, sinusitis, pharyngitis, cystitis, viral gastroenteritis, oral herpes, tooth infection, laryngitis, tinea pedis; neutropenia, anaemia; mild allergic reactions; anxiety; paraesthesia, sciatica, carpal tunnel syndrome; hypertension; upper abdominal pain, vomiting, toothache; rash, acne; musculoskeletal pain, myalgia; pollakiuria; menorrhagia; pain; increased γ-glutamyltransferase & aspartate aminotransferase, decreased weight, neutrophil & white blood cell counts.
cautionsAndWarnings: - Monitor and assess BP, alanine aminotransferase & CBC i.e., differential WBC & platelet count prior to & during treatment.
- Assess liver enzymes prior to & every 2 wk during 1st 6 mth treatment & every 8 wk thereafter.

- Discontinue use if liver injury is suspected, pulmonary symptoms e.g., persistent cough & dyspnoea, severe haematological reactions i.e., pancytopenia, ulcerative stomatitis, skin &/or mucosal reactions, peripheral neuropathy occurs.
- Pre-existing liver disease, hypoproteinaemia, active acute or chronic infections, latent TB, history of interstitial lung diseases.
- Delay initiation in patients w/ severe active infection until resolution.
- Avoid use of live attenuated vaccines.
- Concomitant with leflunomide, interferon β or glatiramer acetate, alcohol.
- Galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption.
- May affect ability to drive & use machines.
- Children 10-18 yr.
- Elderly ≥65 yr.

standardDosage.adult: 50 mg to 200 mg daily

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Nilai status prestasi (ECOG / Indeks Frailty), rizab sumsum tulang, dan fungsi renal sebelum setiap kitaran rawatan.

sideEffects: Severe birth defects, fetal death, drowsiness, somnolence, peripheral neuropathy, dizziness, orthostatic hypotension, neutropenia, increase of viral load in HIV-infected patients, hypersensitivity reaction, bradycardia, rash; physical & psychological abuse & dependence. Potentially Fatal: Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis and blood dyscrasias.
cautionsAndWarnings: All females of childbearing potential must use 2 reliable forms of contraception simultaneously 4 weeks before starting therapy, during & 4 weeks after therapy is discontinued. For males, use barrier methods of contraception. Do not donate blood or sperm during therapy. Discontinue therapy if any skin rash develops. Patients should be evaluated periodically. Monitor WBC count regularly. May increase risk of venous thromboembolic events. Peripheral neuropathy. History of seizures, Lapp-lactase deficiency/glucose-galactose malabsorption. May impair ability to drive or operate machinery.
NPRA Safety Alert (5 June 2017)
- Risk of viral reactivation and pulmonary hypertension

atcCategory: Alimentary Tract and Metabolism - Vitamins
indications: i) For the prevention or treatment of Vitamin B1 deficiency syndromes including beri-beri and peripheral neuritis associated with pellagra ii) Wernicke-Korsakoff Syndrome
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to thiamine or any component

standardDosage.adult: i) Mild to chronic deficiency: 10-25 mg daily. Severe deficiency: 200- 300 mg daily ii) 500 mg every 8 hours for 2 days, followed by 100 mg 2 times daily until patient can take oral dose
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos pada bayi dan kanak-kanak wajib dihitung berdasarkan berat badan (mg/kg) mengikut garis panduan Formulari Pediatrik KKM. Rundingan pakar disyorkan untuk penggunaan luar label atau neonat.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos standard.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Gangguan sederhana — pertimbangkan pengurangan dos 25-50% atau panjangkan selang pemberian.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Gangguan teruk — titrasi berhati-hati dengan pemantauan klinikal dan makmal.

Mulakan pada julat dos terendah (50% daripada dos pemula dewasa standard) dan titrasi secara perlahan dengan pemantauan fungsi buah pinggang dan kognitif.

IM: Tenderness and indurations. Very rarely, fatal anaphylactic shock.
cautionsAndWarnings: Use with caution with parenteral route (especially IV) of administration

therapeuticClass: Pituitary and Hypothalamic Hormones and Analogues
indications: Thyrogen (thyrotropin alfa) is indicated for use as an adjunctive treatment for radioiodine ablation of thyroid tissue remnants in patients who have undergone a near-total or total thyroidectomy for well-differentiated thyroid cancer and who do not have evidence of distant metastatic thyroid cancer.
contraindications: None

standardDosage.adult:
A two-injection regimen is recommended for thyrotropin administration.
The two-injection regimen is thyrotropin 0.9 mg intramuscularly (IM), followed by a second 0.9 mg IM injection 24 hours later. 
After reconstitution with 1.2 mL Sterile Water for Injection, 1.0 mL solution (0.9 mg thyrotropin alfa) is administered by intramuscular injection to the buttock. 

For radioiodine imaging or treatment, radioiodine administration should be given 24 hours following the final Thyrogen injection. Diagnostic scanning should be performed 48 hours after radioiodine administration, whereas post-therapy scanning may be delayed additional days to allow background activity to decline.

atcCategory: Blood and Blood Forming Organs - Antihemorrhagics

contraindications: Severe renal impairment, thromboembolic disease, intravascular clotting process, disturbance of colour vision, subarachnoid haemorrhage

atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Antineoplastic Agents
indications: i) Used only in adjuvant setting for patients with HER2 over-expressed breast cancer, that is HER2 3+ by immunohistochemistry and over-expressed by FISH (Fluorescence in situ hybridization) and high risk group

ii) Treatment of HER2-positive non-metastatic breast cancer in combination with neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by adjuvant trastuzumab, for locally advanced (including inflammatory) breast cancer or tumours >2cm in diameter.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to trastuzumab or foreign proteins (Chinese Hamster Ovary cell proteins or murine protein) or any other product component. Concomitant treatment with anthracyclines (if possible avoid for 24 weeks after trastuzumab is stopped), patients who suffer from dyspnea at rest due to advanced malignancy or comorbidities.
psxRestrictions: ii) To be prescribed by oncologists only

standardDosage.adult:
i) Initial loading dose is 4 mg/kg administered as a 90 minutes IV infusion. Subsequent doses is 2 mg/kg administered as 30 minutes IV infusion weekly for 51 weeks

ii) Initial loading dose of 8 mg/kg body weight, followed by 6 mg/kg body weight 3 weeks later and then 6 mg/kg repeated at 3-weekly intervals administered as infusions over approximately 90 minutes. If the prior dose was well tolerated, the dose can be administered as a 30-minute infusion.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos kemoterapi dalam pediatrik adalah berasaskan protokol ketat dihitung menggunakan Luas Permukaan Badan (mg/m²) atau berat (mg/kg) mengikut Protokol Onkologi Pediatrik Malaysia (MASPO / SIOP). Memerlukan pengesahan bebas dua pegawai farmasi onkologi.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: 100% dos protokol.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Pengurangan dos mengikut protokol onkologi khusus (biasanya pengurangan 25-50% untuk Cisplatin, Carboplatin, Methotrexate, Capecitabine).
• CrCl < 10 mL/min: Semakan ketat Pakar Onkologi.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Nilai status prestasi (ECOG / Indeks Frailty), rizab sumsum tulang, dan fungsi renal sebelum setiap kitaran rawatan.

sideEffects: Cardiotoxicity, infusion reactions, hematotoxicity (anemia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia), pulmonary adverse events, chills, fever, rash, nausea and vomiting, dyspnea and headache, tremor, serious anaphylactic reactions, gastrointestinal disturbances, erythema, rash, musculoskeletal pain
cautionsAndWarnings: Cardiac dysfunction (heart failure, coronary artery disease), cardiotoxicity. Monitor cardiac function carefully during treatment (e.g. every three months), more frequently if asymptomatic cardiac dysfunction develops. Infusion-related reaction, pulmonary toxicity, anaphylaxis, respiratory distress, benzyl alcohol hypersensitivity, geriatric, intrinsic lung disease, neutropenia.

interactions.effect: Coadministration of trastuzumab and chemotherapy or anastrozole does not appear to affect the pharmacokinetics of trastuzumab.

sideEffects: Eye irritation, ocular hyperaemia. standardDosage.adult: Smaller joints: 2.5 - 5 mg and larger joints: 5 - 15 mg. Treatment should be limited to 1 mg/injection site to prevent cutaneous atrophy
standardDosage.pediatric: Prednisolone / Hydrocortisone: Asma akut / Anti-radang: 1 - 2 mg/kg/day PO dibahagikan OD atau BD selama 3-5 hari (Maks: 40-60 mg/hari). Croup teruk: Dexamethasone 0.15 - 0.6 mg/kg dos tunggal PO/IM/IV. Terapi berpanjangan memerlukan pemantauan tumbesaran.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:

Pheochromocytoma crisis, which may be fatal, has been reported after administration of systemic corticosteroids. Corticosteroids should only be administered to patients with suspected or identified pheochromocytoma after an appropriate risk/benefit evaluation.

atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Endocrine Therapy
indications: i) Treatment of confirmed central precocious puberty (preterm sexual development) (before 8 years in girls and 10 years in boys)

ii) Genital and extragenital endometriosis (stage I to stage IV). Treatment should not be administered for more than 6 months. It is not recommended to start a second treatment course with triptorelin or another GnRH analogue.
contraindications: Should never be used during pregnancy. Confirm the patient is not pregnant before starting the treatment.

standardDosage.adult: 1 intramuscular injection every 4 weeks. The treatment must be started in the first 5 days of the menstrual cycle. The duration of treatment depends on the initial severity of the endometriosis and the changes observed in the clinical features. In principle, the treatment should be administered for at least 4 months and for at most 6 months. It is not recommended to start a second treatment course with triptorelin or another GnRH analogue.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos pada bayi dan kanak-kanak wajib dihitung berdasarkan berat badan (mg/kg) mengikut garis panduan Formulari Pediatrik KKM. Rundingan pakar disyorkan untuk penggunaan luar label atau neonat.
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos standard.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Gangguan sederhana — pertimbangkan pengurangan dos 25-50% atau panjangkan selang pemberian.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Gangguan teruk — titrasi berhati-hati dengan pemantauan klinikal dan makmal.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Mulakan pada julat dos terendah (50% daripada dos pemula dewasa standard) dan titrasi secara perlahan dengan pemantauan fungsi buah pinggang dan kognitif.

sideEffects: Pelvic pain, dysmenorhoea (symptoms of endometriosis) may be appeared during the initial treatment. Metrorrhagia may be occurring in the month following. During treatment: hot flushes, vaginal dryness, decrease libido and dyspareunia, are related to pituitary-ovarian blockade. Rare cases of headache, arthralgia and myalgia. Allergic reactions such as urticarial, rash, pruritis and veryu ocassionaly oedema. Nausea, vomiting, weight gain, hypertension, mood disorders, visual disturbances, pain at the injection site and fever. The prolonged use may lead to bone loss, a risk factor for possible osteoporosis.
cautionsAndWarnings: Regular administration, every four weeks, of one vial of triptoreline 3.75mg results in a constant hypogonadotropic amenorroea. A supervening metrorrhagia in the course of treatment, other than in the first month, is abnormal and should lead to measurement plasma oestradiol levels. Shoould this level be less than 50 pg/ml possible associated organic lesions should be sought. Ovarian function resumes after the treatment is withdrawn and ovulation occurs on average 58 days after the last injection. The first menses occur on average 70 days after the last injection and contraception may therefore be required.

genericName: Triptoreline 11.25mg Powder and Solvent for Suspension for Injection
atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Endocrine Therapy
dosageForms: 11.25mg Powder and Solvent for Suspension for Injection
indications: i.	Treatment of confirmed central precocious puberty (preterm sexual development) (before 8 years in girls and 10 years in boys)

ii.	Genital and extragenital endometriosis (stage I to stage IV). Treatment should not be administered for more than 6 months. It is not recommended to start a second treatment course with triptorelin or another GnRH analogue.
iii.	Treatment of locally advanced prostate cancer when used alone or as concomitant and adjuvant radiotherapy.
iv.	Treatment of metastatic prostate cancer.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to GnRH, its analogues or to one of the constituents. Pregnancy and lactation period.
psxRestrictions:
Indikasi i:	First-line treatment for central precocious puberty
Indikasi ii: Second-line treatment for genital and extragenital endometriosis

standardDosage.adult:
indikasi i:
Children over 20 kg in body weight: One intramuscular injection of triptorelin 11.25 mg administered every 3 months. 

Treatment should be stopped around the physiological age of puberty in boys and girls and it is recommended that treatment is not continued in girls with a bone maturation of more than 12 to 13 years. There are limited data available in boys relating to the optimum time to stop treatment based on bone age, however it is advised that treatment is stopped in boys with a bone maturation age of 13 to 14 years.

Indikasi ii:
One intramuscular injection of triptorelin repeated every 3 months. The subcutaneous administration has not been studied in women. The treatment must be started in the first five days of the menstrual cycle.

Duration of treatment: This depends on the initial severity of the endometriosis and the changes observed in the clinical features (functional and anatomical) during treatment. The treatment should not be administered for more than 6 months

Indikasi iii & iv:
11.25mg every 3 months

[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos standard.
• CrCl 10 - 50 mL/min: Gangguan sederhana — pertimbangkan pengurangan dos 25-50% atau panjangkan selang pemberian.
• CrCl < 10 mL/min / Hemodialisis: Gangguan teruk — titrasi berhati-hati dengan pemantauan klinikal dan makmal.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Mulakan pada julat dos terendah (50% daripada dos pemula dewasa standard) dan titrasi secara perlahan dengan pemantauan fungsi buah pinggang dan kognitif.

sideEffects: Anaemia, hypersensitivity, libido decreased, depression, loss of libido, mood swings, paraesthesia in lower limbs, dizziness, headache, hot flush, hypertension, dry mouth, nausea, hyperhidrosis, musculoskeletal pain, pain in extremity, erectile dysfunction (including ejaculation failure, ejaculation disorder), pelvic pain, asthenia, injection site (including erythema, inflammation and pain), oedema, weight increased.
cautionsAndWarnings: Bone loss (risk of osteoporosis), gonadotroph cell pituitary adenoma, incident depression, treatment with anti-coagulants

Specific precaution in men: transient increase in serum testosterone levels, temporary worsening of signs and symptoms of prostate cancer and temporary increase in cancer related pain (metastatic pain), spinal cord compression or urethral obstruction, QT interval prolongation, metabolic changes (e.g. glucose intolerance, fatty liver), or an increased risk of cardiovascular disease, suppression of the pituitary gonadal system, increase in acid phosphatases
Specific precaution in women: bone mineral density reduction, adolescent and young women (specially less than 16 years of age), genital haemorrhage/menstruation.

Specific precaution in paediatric: progressive brain tumours, pseudo-precocious puberty and gonadotropin-independent precocious puberty, bone mineral density reduction, slipped capital femoral epiphysis, Idiopathic intracranial hypertension.

atcCategory: Antineoplastic and Immunomodulating Agents - Immunosuppressants
indications: 1. Indicated for the treatment of severe atopic dermatitis in adults and adolescents 12 years and older who are candidates for systemic therapy.

2. Indicated for the treatment of active psoriatic arthritis in adult patients who have responded inadequately to, or who are intolerant to one or more DMARDs. May be used as monotherapy or in combination with methotrexate.

3. Indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe active rheumatoid arthritis in adult patients who have responded inadequately to, or who are intolerant to one or more disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drugs (DMARDs). Upadacitinib may be used as monotherapy or in combination with methotrexate.

4. For the treatment of adult patients with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis who have had an inadequate response, lost response or were intolerant to either conventional therapy or a biologic agent.

5. For the treatment of adult patients with moderately to severely active Crohn’s disease who have had an inadequate response, lost response or were intolerant to either conventional therapy or a biologic agent.
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients, active tuberculosis (TB) or active serious infections, severe hepatic impairment, pregnancy.
psxRestrictions:
Indication 1 (severe atopic dermatitis):
i.	As fourth line of treatment in patients who have failed / have contraindications / experienced adverse events to:  
•	Intensive and optimized topical treatment  
•	Phototherapy  
•	At least two immunosuppressants  
ii.	To be prescribed by Dermatologists only.

Indication 2 (active psoriatic arthritis): To be prescribed by Rheumatologist only

Indication 3 (moderate to severe active rheumatoid arthritis):
i.	To be prescribed after failing/ intolerance/ contraindicated to csDMARDs (as per Malaysian Consensus on Biologic Usage) and one biologic DMARDs.
ii.	To be prescribed by Rheumatologist only

Indication 4 (active ulcerative colitis):
As a second line therapy and to be prescribed by gastroenterologists experienced in inflammatory bowel disease management.

Indication 5 (Crohn's disease) - None

standardDosage.adult:
Indication 1 (severe atopic dermatitis):
Adults: The recommended dose of upadacitinib is 15 mg or 30 mg once daily based on individual patient presentation (Refer to package insert). The lowest effective dose for maintenance should be considered.

Adolescents (from 12 to 17 years of age): The recommended dose of upadacitinib is 15 mg once daily for adolescents weighing at least 40 kg.

Upadacitinib can be used with or without concomitant topical therapies (Refer package insert)

Indication 2 & 3 (active psoriatic arthritis & moderate to severe active rheumatoid arthritis): 15 mg once daily

Indication 4 (active ulcerative colitis):
Induction
The recommended induction dose of upadacitinib is 45 mg once daily for 8 weeks.

Maintenance
The recommended maintenance dose of upadacitinib is 15 mg or 30 mg once daily based on individual patient presentation.

Indication 5 (Crohn's disease)
Induction
The recommended induction dose of upadacitinib is 45 mg once daily for 12 weeks.

If residual clot remains, leave 0.3ml in the anterior chambers for 24-48 hours to facilitate futher dissolution

genericName: Valproic Acid and Sodium Valproate (ER) 500mg Tablet
atcCategory: Nervous System - Antiepileptics
indications: i) In the treatment of generalized or partial epilepsy, particularly with the following patterns of seizures:absence, myoclonic, tonic-clonic, atonic-mixed as well as, for partial epilepsy:simple or complex seizures, secondary generalized seizures, specific syndrome (West, Lennox-Gastatut).

contraindications: Hepatic disease or significant hepatic dysfunction, hypersensitivity to valproate sodium, valproic acid or divalproex sodium, porphyria
NPRA Safety Alert (31 Jan 2019):
• Epilepsy:
- valproate is contraindicated in pregnancy unless there is no suitable alternative treatment.
- valproate is contraindicated in women of childbearing potential, unless the conditions described in the Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (DHPC) letter are fulfilled.
• Bipolar disorder:
- valproate is contraindicated in pregnancy.
- valproate is contraindicated in women of childbearing potential, unless the conditions described in the DHPC letter are fulfilled.

standardDosage.adult: i) Adults: Dosage should start at 500mg daily increasing by 200mg at three-day intervals until control is achieved. This is generally within the dosage range 1000mg to 2000mg per day.

sideEffects: Nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, ataxia, tremor, weight gain, transient hair loss, oedema, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia. Liver dysfunction, gastrointestinal disorders

standardDosage.adult:

indications: Indicated as adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycaemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus, as monotherapy when metformin is contraindicated or not tolerated and as add-on therapy to other glucose-lowering agents when adequate glycaemic control is not achieved despite dose optimisation.

• CrCl < 30 mL/min / ESRD: Metformin dan SGLT2i adalah KONTRAINDIKASI; tukar kepada Insulin atau Linagliptin.
• Pantau SMBG kerap untuk elak hipoglikemia.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:

sideEffects: Tremor, dizziness, headache, nausea, asthenia, hypoglycaemia, weight increase, oedema peripheral, hyperhidrosis, decreased blood glucose, headache, chills, gastro-oesophageal reflux disease.
cautionsAndWarnings: Vildagliptin is not a substitute for insulin in insulin-requiring patients. Vildagliptin should not be used in patients with type 1 diabetes or for the treatment of diabetic ketoacidosis. Renal Impairment. Hepatic impairment. Liver enzyme monitoring. Cardiac failure. Skin disorders. Pancreatitis. Hypoglycaemia. Patients receiving vildagliptin in combination with a sulphonylurea may be at risk of hypoglycaemia. Pregnancy, lactation.

interactions.effect: Low potential for interactions with co-administered medicinal products. Since vildagliptin is not a cytochrome P (CYP) 450 enzyme substrate and dose not inhibit or induced CYP 450 enzymes, it is not likely to interact with active substances that are substrate, inhibitors or inducers of these enzymes. Hypoglycaemic effect of vildagliptin may be reduced by certain active substances including thiazides, corticosteroids, thyroid products, sympathomimetics.

standardDosage.adult: Initially, 3.7 mg/m2, increase dose weekly based on WBC counts in increments of about 1.8 mg/m2 until leukocyte count decreases to about 3000/mm3, or maximum weekly dose of 18.5 mg/m2 reached. Child: Initial 2.5 mg/m2 of BSA, increased dose at weekly intervals in increments of about 1.25 mg/m2 until leukocyte count decreases to about 3000/ mm3, or maximum weekly dose of 12.5 mg/m2 reached. Do not increase dose once leukocyte count reaches approximately 3000 cells/mm3, instead, a dose of 1 increment smaller to be admin at wkly intervals for maintenance. Do not administer next dose, even though 7 days have lapsed unless the leukocyte count has returned to at least 4000/mm3.

sideEffects: Nausea, decreased appetite, abnormal dreams, dizziness, diarrhoea, constipation, vomiting, generalized pruritus.
cautionsAndWarnings: Suicide/suicidal thoughts or clinical worsening, seizures, serotonin syndrome or neuroleptic malignant syndrome, mania/hypomania, haemorrhage, hyponatraemia, renal Impairment, hepatic impairment, elderly & paediatric populations, pregnancy & lactation.

Dosing is individualised based on patient’s INR and according product insert/protocol/ guideline.
standardDosage.pediatric:
Antikoagulasi pediatrik diawasi ketat oleh Pakar Hematologi Pediatrik:
• Dos pemula: 0.1 - 0.2 mg/kg PO sekali sehari (Sasaran INR 2.0 - 3.0 mengikut indikasi klinikal).
standardDosage.elderlyOrRenal:
[PELARASAN GANGGUAN BUAH PINGGANG (RENAL DOSING)]:
• CrCl > 50 mL/min: Dos normal.
• CrCl 30 - 50 mL/min: Enoxaparin dos normal atau kurangkan pada warga emas; DOAC kurangkan dos.
• CrCl < 30 mL/min: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC sekali sehari (OD); DOAC adalah KONTRAINDIKASI / ELAKKAN; Warfarin / Heparin Tidak Terpecah (UFH) lebih diutamakan.
• Hemodialisis: UFH semasa sesi dialisis.

[WARGA EMAS & GANGGUAN HATI (GERIATRIC & HEPATIC)]:
Risiko pendarahan tinggi (Skor HAS-BLED). Pantau risiko jatuh, pendarahan saluran gastrousus tersembunyi, dan pendarahan intrakranial.

sideEffects: Haemorrhage, alopecia, fever, gastrointestinal disorders, hypersensitivity reactions, `purple toes'. Occasionally skin necrosis (obese elderly patients), jaundice, hepatic dysfunction, nausea, vomiting, pancreatitis
NPRA Safety Alert
Anticoagulant-related nephropathy
cautionsAndWarnings: Severe to moderate hepatic or renal insufficiency, concomitant use of antiplatelet drugs or drugs with ulcerogenic activity. Surgery and dental extraction, congestive heart failure. Concurrent use with thrombolytic drugs, known or suspected protein C deficiency. Moderate to severe hypertension, severe diabetes, severe allergic or anaphylactic disorders. Patients with hyperthyroidism or hypothyroidism may have a substantially altered response to warfarin. Avoid concurrent use with herbal medicines and limit Vitamin K rich vegetables
NPRA Safety Alert
Anticoagulant-related nephropathy
- patients with altered glomerular integrity or with a history of kidney disease
Risk of Atraumatic Splenic Rupture

atcCategory: Antiinfectives for Systemic Use - Antivirals for Systemic Use
indications: To reduce the rate of maternal-foetal transmission of HIV in:
i) HIV-positive pregnant women over 14 weeks of gestation;
ii) Their newborn infants
contraindications: Abnormally low neutrophil cell count (less than 0.75 x 109/L) or abnormally low Hb levels (less than 7.5 g/dL). Hypersensitivity to zidovudine. New born infants with hyperbilirubinaemia requiring treatment other than phototherapy, or increased transaminase levels of over five times than the upper limit of normal.

standardDosage.adult: i) Prophylaxis of maternal-foetal HIV transmission during labour and delivery Adult: Loading dose: 2 mg/kg, followed by continuous infusion of 1 mg/kg/hr until umbilical cord is clamped. If caesarean section is planned, start the IV infusion 4 hr before the operation. Renal and Hepatic impairment: Dose reduction may be needed. HIV infection (to be discuss: not in indication) Adult: 1-2 mg/kg every 4 hr, given as 2-4 mg/ml infusion over 1 hr. Child: As continuous infusion: 20 mg/m2/hr. Alternatively, as intermittent infusion: 120 mg/m2 every 6 hr. Renal impairment: Haemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis: 1 mg/kg every 6-8 hr. ii) Prophylaxis of HIV infection in neonates Child: Neonates: 1.5 mg/kg every 6 hr. Start treatment within 12 hr after birth and continue for 1st 6 wk of life. Dose to be given via IV infusion over 30 minutes. Renal impairment: Dose adjustment may be needed.
standardDosage.pediatric: Dos pediatrik dihitung mengikut berat badan (mg/kg/dos) per indikasi klinikal FUKKM. Bagi neonat (<28 hari), dos diselaraskan mengikut berat lahir dan umur gestasi.

pregnancyAndLactation.pregnancyReason: Berpotensi memberi kesan buruk kepada perkembangan sistem organ janin. Penilaian klinikal mendalam oleh Pakar Perubatan diperlukan.
pregnancyAndLactation.trimester1: Gunakan hanya jika ada indikasi klinikal mustahak yang disahkan oleh Pakar Perubatan.
pregnancyAndLactation.trimester2_3: Pantau perkembangan janin dan tanda-tanda klinikal ibu secara berkala.
pregnancyAndLactation.lactationReason: Kuantiti kecil mungkin dikumuhkan ke dalam susu ibu. Ambil dos sejurus selepas menyusukan bayi bagi meminimumkan kepekatan dalam susu.
pregnancyAndLactation.infantMonitoringAdvice: Pantau bayi untuk sebarang tanda kelesuan luar biasa, perubahan selera menyusu, atau cirit-birit.
